1.6.3.d: बहुरूपा हि पशवः समृद्ध्यै । अग्निं मन्थन्ति । अग्निमुखा वै प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । यदग्निं मन्थन्ति । अग्निमुखा एव तत्प्रजा यजमानः सृजते । नव प्रयाजा इज्यन्ते । नवानूयाजाः । अष्टौ हवींषि । द्वावाघारौ । द्वावाज्यभागौ
1.6.3.m: for domestic animals are multiform, for success. / They churn the fire. / With Agni as mouth did Prajāpati create offspring. / When they churn the fire, / the sacrificer creates offspring with Agni as mouth. / Nine fore-offerings are sacrificed, / nine after-offerings, / eight oblations, / two ghee pours, / two butter portions.

1.6.3.s: triṃśathsaṃpadyante | triṃśadakṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | teja ājyam | yadekakapāla ājyamānayati | yajamānameva tejasā samardhayati | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | paśava ājyam
1.6.3.d: त्रिंशथ्संपद्यन्ते । त्रिंशदक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । यजमानो वा एककपालः । तेज आज्यम् । यदेककपाल आज्यमानयति । यजमानमेव तेजसा समर्धयति । यजमानो वा एककपालः । पशव आज्यम्
1.6.3.m:
They amount to thirty. / The virāj has thirty syllables; / the virāj is food; / through the virāj he wins edible food. / The single potsherd [cake] is the sacrificer; / ghee is fiery energy. / When he pours ghee upon the single potsherd [cake], / he supplies the sacrificer with fiery energy. / The single potsherd [cake] is the sacrificer; / ghee is domestic animals.

When he pours ghee upon the single potsherd [cake], / he supplies the sacrificer with domestic animals. / If he should pour a little, / few domestic animals, enjoying [him], would attend him. / If he should pour much, / many domestic animals, enjoying [him], would attend him. / Having poured much, he should make its back visible; / many domestic animals indeed, enjoying [him], attend him. / The single potsherd [cake] is the sacrificer. / If one were to cut a portion from the single potsherd [cake],

1.6.3.s: yadekakapāla ājyamānayati | yajamānameva paśubhiḥ samardhayati | yadalpamānayet | alpā enaṃ paśavo bhuñjanta upatiṣṭheran | yadbahvānayet | bahava enaṃ paśavo'bhuñjanta upatiṣṭheran | bahvānīyāviḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryāt | bahava evainaṃ paśavo bhuñjanta upatiṣṭhante | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | yadekakapālasyāvadyet
1.6.3.d: यदेककपाल आज्यमानयति । यजमानमेव पशुभिः समर्धयति । यदल्पमानयेत् । अल्पा एनं पशवो भुञ्जन्त उपतिष्ठेरन् । यद्बह्वानयेत् । बहव एनं पशवोऽभुञ्जन्त उपतिष्ठेरन् । बह्वानीयाविः पृष्ठं कुर्यात् । बहव एवैनं पशवो भुञ्जन्त उपतिष्ठन्ते । यजमानो वा एककपालः । यदेककपालस्यावद्येत्

1.6.3.s: yajamānasyāvadyet | udvā mādyedyajamānaḥ | pra vā mīyeta | sakṛdeva hotavyaḥ | sakṛdiva hi suvargo lokaḥ | hutvā'bhi juhoti | yajamānameva suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayitvā | tejasā samardhayati | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | suvargo loka āhavanīyaḥ
1.6.3.d: यजमानस्यावद्येत् । उद्वा माद्येद्यजमानः । प्र वा मीयेत । सकृदेव होतव्यः । सकृदिव हि सुवर्गो लोकः । हुत्वाऽभि जुहोति । यजमानमेव सुवर्गं लोकं गमयित्वा । तेजसा समर्धयति । यजमानो वा एककपालः । सुवर्गो लोक आहवनीयः
1.6.3.m: one would cut off a portion of the sacrificer; / the sacrificer would either go mad / or perish. / It should be offered just once, / for the heavenly realm is, as it were, once [attained]. / Having offered [it], he makes an additional oblation over it. / Having brought the sacrificer to the heavenly realm, / he supplies [him] with fiery energy. / The single potsherd [cake] is the sacrificer; / the heavenly realm is the āhavanīya fire.

1.6.3.s: yadekakapālamāhavanīye juhoti | yajamānameva suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | yaddhastena juhuyāt | suvargāllokādyajamānamavavidhyet | srucā juhoti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | yatprāṅpadyeta | devalokamabhi jayet | yaddakṣiṇā pitṛlokam | yatpratyak
1.6.3.d: यदेककपालमाहवनीये जुहोति । यजमानमेव सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति । यद्धस्तेन जुहुयात् । सुवर्गाल्लोकाद्यजमानमवविध्येत् । स्रुचा जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । यत्प्राङ्पद्येत । देवलोकमभि जयेत् । यद्दक्षिणा पितृलोकम् । यत्प्रत्यक्
1.6.3.m: When he offers the single potsherd [cake] in the āhavanīya, / he brings the sacrificer to the heavenly realm. / If he were to offer with the hand, / he would cast the sacrificer away from the heavenly realm. / He offers with the ladle, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / If it should fall eastward, / he would win the world of the gods; / if southward, the world of the ancestors; / if westward,

1.6.3.s: rakṣāṃsi yajñaṃ hanyuḥ | yadudaṅṅ | manuṣyalokamabhijayet | pratiṣṭhito hotavyaḥ | ekakapālaṃ vai pratitiṣṭhantaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī anu pratitiṣṭhataḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūn yajñaḥ | yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ | yajamānaṃ prajāḥ | tasmātpratiṣṭhito hotavyaḥ
1.6.3.d: रक्षांसि यज्ञं हन्युः । यदुदङ्ङ् । मनुष्यलोकमभिजयेत् । प्रतिष्ठितो होतव्यः । एककपालं वै प्रतितिष्ठन्तं द्यावापृथिवी अनु प्रतितिष्ठतः । द्यावापृथिवी ऋतवः । ऋतून् यज्ञः । यज्ञं यजमानः । यजमानं प्रजाः । तस्मात्प्रतिष्ठितो होतव्यः
1.6.3.m: the rakṣases would slay the sacrifice; / if northward, / he would win the world of humans. / It must be offered while standing firm. / Following the single potsherd [cake] standing firm, heaven and earth stand firm; / following heaven and earth, the seasons; / following the seasons, the sacrifice; / following the sacrifice, the sacrificer; / following the sacrificer, offspring. / Therefore it must be offered while standing firm.

1.6.3.s: vājino yajati | agnirvāyuḥ sūryaḥ | te vai vājinaḥ | tāneva tadyajati | atho khalvāhuḥ | chandāṃsi vai vājina iti | tānyeva tadyajati | ṛkhsāme vā indrasya harī somapānau | tayoḥ paridhaya ādhānam | vājinaṃ bhāgadheyam
1.6.3.d: वाजिनो यजति । अग्निर्वायुः सूर्यः । ते वै वाजिनः । तानेव तद्यजति । अथो खल्वाहुः । छन्दांसि वै वाजिन इति । तान्येव तद्यजति । ऋख्सामे वा इन्द्रस्य हरी सोमपानौ । तयोः परिधय आधानम् । वाजिनं भागधेयम्
1.6.3.m: He sacrifices to the Vājins: / Agni, Vāyu, Sūrya— / these indeed are the Vājins; / it is them that he sacrifices to. / Moreover they say: / 'The metres indeed are the Vājins'; / it is them that he sacrifices to. / The Ṛk and the Sāman are Indra's two bay steeds, soma-drinkers; / the enclosing sticks are their stall, / the whey is their portion.

1.6.3.s: yadaprahṛtya paridhīñjuhuyāt | antarādhānābhyāṃ ghāsaṃ prayacchet | prahṛtya paridhīñjuhoti | nirādhānābhyāmeva ghāsaṃ prayacchati | barhiṣi viṣiñcanvājinamānayati | prajā vai barhiḥ | reto vājinam | prajāsveva reto dadhāti | samupahūya bhakṣayanti | etathsomapīthā hyete | atho ātmanneva reto dadhate | yajamāna uttamo bhakṣayati | paśavo vai vājinam | yajamāna eva paśūnpratiṣṭhāpayanti
1.6.3.d: यदप्रहृत्य परिधीञ्जुहुयात् । अन्तराधानाभ्यां घासं प्रयच्छेत् । प्रहृत्य परिधीञ्जुहोति । निराधानाभ्यामेव घासं प्रयच्छति । बर्हिषि विषिञ्चन्वाजिनमानयति । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । रेतो वाजिनम् । प्रजास्वेव रेतो दधाति । समुपहूय भक्षयन्ति । एतथ्सोमपीथा ह्येते । अथो आत्मन्नेव रेतो दधते । यजमान उत्तमो भक्षयति । पशवो वै वाजिनम् । यजमान एव पशून्प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति
1.6.3.m: If he should offer without throwing in the enclosing sticks, / he would give fodder [to the horses] while the stalls are between [them]; / having thrown in the enclosing sticks, he offers; / he gives fodder [to them] without stalls intervening. / Spattering it upon the sacrificial grass, he brings the whey. / Offspring is the sacrificial grass; / semen is the whey; / he places semen in offspring. / Having invited each other, they consume [it], / for they are soma-drinkers in this rite; / moreover, they place semen in themselves. / The sacrificer consumes last. / The whey is domestic animals; / they establish domestic animals in the sacrificer.

1.6.4.s: prajāpatiḥ savitā bhūtvā prajā asṛjata | tā enamatyamanyanta | tā asmādapākrāman | tā varuṇo bhūtvā prajā varuṇenāgrāhayat | tāḥ prajā varuṇagṛhītāḥ | prajāpatiṃ punarupādhāvannāthamicchamānāḥ | sa etānprajāpatirvaruṇapraghāsānapaśyat | tānniravapat | tairvai sa prajā varuṇapāśādamuñcat | yadvaruṇapraghāsā nirupyante
1.6.4.d: प्रजापतिः सविता भूत्वा प्रजा असृजत । ता एनमत्यमन्यन्त । ता अस्मादपाक्रामन् । ता वरुणो भूत्वा प्रजा वरुणेनाग्राहयत् । ताः प्रजा वरुणगृहीताः । प्रजापतिं पुनरुपाधावन्नाथमिच्छमानाः । स एतान्प्रजापतिर्वरुणप्रघासानपश्यत् । तान्निरवपत् । तैर्वै स प्रजा वरुणपाशादमुञ्चत् । यद्वरुणप्रघासा निरुप्यन्ते
1.6.4.m: Prajāpati, having become Savitṛ, created offspring. / They thought themselves superior to him; / they departed from him. / Having become Varuṇa, he caused offspring to be seized by Varuṇa. / Those offspring, seized by Varuṇa, / ran back to Prajāpati, seeking a protector. / Prajāpati beheld these Varuṇapraghāsa offerings; / he offered them. / By means of them he freed offspring from Varuṇa's noose. / When the Varuṇapraghāsa offerings are made,

1.6.4.s: prajānāmavaruṇagrāhāya | tāsāṃ dakṣiṇo bāhurnyakna āsīt | savyaḥ prasṛtaḥ | sa etāṃ dvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇato vedimudahan | tato vai sa prajānāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ prāsārayat | yaddvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇato vedimuddhanti | prajānāmeva tadyajamāno dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ prasārayati | tasmāccāturmāsyayājyamuṣmiṃ lloka ubhayābāhuḥ | yajñābhijitagg hyasya | pṛthamātrādvedī asaṃbhinne bhavataḥ
1.6.4.d: प्रजानामवरुणग्राहाय । तासां दक्षिणो बाहुर्न्यक्न आसीत् । सव्यः प्रसृतः । स एतां द्वितीयां दक्षिणतो वेदिमुदहन् । ततो वै स प्रजानां दक्षिणं बाहुं प्रासारयत् । यद्द्वितीयां दक्षिणतो वेदिमुद्धन्ति । प्रजानामेव तद्यजमानो दक्षिणं बाहुं प्रसारयति । तस्माच्चातुर्मास्ययाज्यमुष्मिं ल्लोक उभयाबाहुः । यज्ञाभिजितग्ग् ह्यस्य । पृथमात्राद्वेदी असंभिन्ने भवतः
1.6.4.m: it is to prevent offspring from being seized by Varuṇa. / Their right arm was bent inwards, / the left stretched out. / He dug out this second altar on the south; / thereupon he stretched out the right arm of offspring. / In that he digs out the second altar on the south, / therefore the sacrificer of the seasonal offerings has both arms in yonder world, / for it is won for him through the sacrifice. / The two altars are kept separate by a span.

1.6.4.s: tasmātpṛthamātraṃ vyaṃsau | uttarasyāṃ vedyāmuttaravedimupa vapati | paśavo vā uttaravediḥ | paśūnevāvarundhe | atho yajñaparuṣo'nantarityai | etadbrāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi | athaiṣa aindrāgno bhavati | prāṇāpānau vā etau devānām | yadindrāgnī | yadaindrāgno bhavati
1.6.4.d: तस्मात्पृथमात्रं व्यंसौ । उत्तरस्यां वेद्यामुत्तरवेदिमुप वपति । पशवो वा उत्तरवेदिः । पशूनेवावरुन्धे । अथो यज्ञपरुषोऽनन्तरित्यै । एतद्ब्राह्मणान्येव पञ्च हवींषि । अथैष ऐन्द्राग्नो भवति । प्राणापानौ वा एतौ देवानाम् । यदिन्द्राग्नी । यदैन्द्राग्नो भवति
1.6.4.m: Therefore [a man] is a span's breadth across the shoulders. / On the northern altar he scatters the high altar. / The high altar is domestic animals; / he wins domestic animals, / and [it serves] for non-interruption of the joints of the sacrifice. / The five oblations have this very brāhmaṇa explanation. / Then there is this [cake] for Indra and Agni. / Indra and Agni are the exhalation and inhalation of the gods. / In that there is [a cake] for Indra and Agni,

1.6.4.s: prāṇāpānāvevāvarundhe | ojo balaṃ vā etau devānām | yadindrāgnī | yadaindrāgno bhavati | ojo balamevāvarundhe | mārutyāmikṣā bhavati | vāruṇyāmikṣā | meṣī ca meṣaśca bhavataḥ | mithunā eva prajā varuṇapāśānmuñcati | lomaśau bhavato medhyatvāya
1.6.4.d: प्राणापानावेवावरुन्धे । ओजो बलं वा एतौ देवानाम् । यदिन्द्राग्नी । यदैन्द्राग्नो भवति । ओजो बलमेवावरुन्धे । मारुत्यामिक्षा भवति । वारुण्यामिक्षा । मेषी च मेषश्च भवतः । मिथुना एव प्रजा वरुणपाशान्मुञ्चति । लोमशौ भवतो मेध्यत्वाय
1.6.4.m: he wins exhalation and inhalation. / Indra and Agni are the splendorous might and strength of the gods. / In that there is [a cake] for Indra and Agni, / he wins splendorous might and strength. / There is a curd mixture for the Maruts, / a curd mixture for Varuṇa; / there are a ewe and a ram; / he frees the offspring from Varuṇa's nooses in pairs. / They are woolly, for sacrificial fitness.

1.6.4.s: śamīparṇānyupa vapati | ghāsamevābhyāmapi yacchati | prajāpatimannādyaṃ nopānamat | sa etena śatedhmena haviṣā'nnādyamavārundha | yatparaḥ śatāni śamīparṇāni bhavanti | annādyasyāvaruddhyai | saumyāni vai karīrāṇi | saumyā khalu vā āhutirdivo vṛṣṭiṃ cyāvayati | yatkarīrāṇi bhavanti | saumyayaivāhutyā divo vṛṣṭimavarundhe | kāya ekakapālo bhavati | prajānāṃ kantvāya | pratipūruṣaṃ karambhapātrāṇi bhavanti | jātā eva prajā varuṇapāśānmuñcati | ekamatiriktam | janiṣyamāṇā eva prajā varuṇapāśānmuñcati
1.6.4.d: शमीपर्णान्युप वपति । घासमेवाभ्यामपि यच्छति । प्रजापतिमन्नाद्यं नोपानमत् । स एतेन शतेध्मेन हविषाऽन्नाद्यमवारुन्ध । यत्परः शतानि शमीपर्णानि भवन्ति । अन्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै । सौम्यानि वै करीराणि । सौम्या खलु वा आहुतिर्दिवो वृष्टिं च्यावयति । यत्करीराणि भवन्ति । सौम्ययैवाहुत्या दिवो वृष्टिमवरुन्धे । काय एककपालो भवति । प्रजानां कन्त्वाय । प्रतिपूरुषं करम्भपात्राणि भवन्ति । जाता एव प्रजा वरुणपाशान्मुञ्चति । एकमतिरिक्तम् । जनिष्यमाणा एव प्रजा वरुणपाशान्मुञ्चति
1.6.4.m: He scatters śamī leaves [upon them]. / He offers fodder to the two of them. / Proper food did not bend to Prajāpati. / By means of this offering with a hundred bundles of firewood, he secured proper food. / When there are more than a hundred śamī leaves, / it is for securing proper food. / Karīra fruits belong to Soma. / Indeed, an oblation belonging to Soma causes rain to fall from the sky. / When there are karīra fruits, / by means of an oblation belonging to Soma he secures rain from the sky. / There is a one-cup [cake] sacred to Ka, / for the happiness of the offspring. / There are karambha dishes for each person. / He frees the born offspring from the noose of Varuṇa. / There is one extra [dish]; / he frees the offspring yet to be born from the noose of Varuṇa.

1.6.5.s: uttarasyāṃ vedyāmanyāni havīṃṣi sādayati | dakṣiṇāyāṃ mārutīm | apadhuramevainā yunakti | atho oja evāsāmava harati | tasmādbrahmaṇaśca kṣattrācca viśo'nyatopakramiṇīḥ | mārutyā pūrvayā pracarati | anṛtamevāva yajate | vāruṇyottarayā | antata eva varuṇamava yajate | yadevādhvaryuḥ karoti
1.6.5.d: उत्तरस्यां वेद्यामन्यानि हवींषि सादयति । दक्षिणायां मारुतीम् । अपधुरमेवैना युनक्ति । अथो ओज एवासामव हरति । तस्माद्ब्रह्मणश्च क्षत्त्राच्च विशोऽन्यतोपक्रमिणीः । मारुत्या पूर्वया प्रचरति । अनृतमेवाव यजते । वारुण्योत्तरया । अन्तत एव वरुणमव यजते । यदेवाध्वर्युः करोति
1.6.5.m: He places the other oblations upon the northern altar, / the [curd] sacred to the Maruts on the southern [altar]. / He hitches it, as it were, away from the yoke. / And he takes away their splendorous might. / Therefore the people (the Viś) turn away elsewhere from the Brahmin and from the regal power. / He performs the rite first with the [oblation] sacred to the Maruts; / he averts falsehood. / With the subsequent [oblation] sacred to Varuṇa, / at the very end he averts Varuṇa. / What the Adhvaryu does,

1.6.5.s: tatpratiprasthātā karoti | tasmādyacchreyānkaroti | tatpāpīyānkaroti | patnīṃ vācayati | medhyāmevaināṃ karoti | atho tapa evaināmupa nayati | yajjāraṃ santaṃ na prabrūyāt | priyaṃ jñātiṃ rundhyāt | asau me jāra iti nirdiśet | nirdiśyaivainaṃ varuṇapāśena grāhayati
1.6.5.d: तत्प्रतिप्रस्थाता करोति । तस्माद्यच्छ्रेयान्करोति । तत्पापीयान्करोति । पत्नीं वाचयति । मेध्यामेवैनां करोति । अथो तप एवैनामुप नयति । यज्जारं सन्तं न प्रब्रूयात् । प्रियं ज्ञातिं रुन्ध्यात् । असौ मे जार इति निर्दिशेत् । निर्दिश्यैवैनं वरुणपाशेन ग्राहयति
1.6.5.m: that the Pratiprasthātṛ does. / Therefore, what the better [person] does, / that the worse [person] does. / He makes the wife speak. / He makes her fit for sacrifice. / And he brings ascetic heat upon her. / If she should not disclose who her lover is, / she would injure a dear relative. / She should point him out: 'So-and-so is my lover.' / Pointing him out, she causes him to be seized by the noose of Varuṇa.

1.6.5.s: praghāsyān havāmaha iti patnīmudānayati | ahvataivainām | yatpatnī puronuvākyāmanu brūyāt | nirvīryo yajamānaḥ syāt | yajamāno'nvāha | ātmanneva vīryaṃ dhatte | ubhau yājyāṃ savīryatvāya | yadgrāme yadaraṇya ityāha | yathoditameva varuṇamava yajate | yajamānadevatyo vā āhavanīyaḥ
1.6.5.d: प्रघास्यान् हवामह इति पत्नीमुदानयति । अह्वतैवैनाम् । यत्पत्नी पुरोनुवाक्यामनु ब्रूयात् । निर्वीर्यो यजमानः स्यात् । यजमानोऽन्वाह । आत्मन्नेव वीर्यं धत्ते । उभौ याज्यां सवीर्यत्वाय । यद्ग्रामे यदरण्य इत्याह । यथोदितमेव वरुणमव यजते । यजमानदेवत्यो वा आहवनीयः
1.6.5.m: With 'We invoke the voracious ones,' he leads the wife up. / He brings her up as one summoned. / If the wife were to recite the introductory verse, / the sacrificer would become devoid of heroic power. / The sacrificer recites it; / he places heroic power in himself. / Both [utter] the offering verse for the sake of possessing heroic power. / When he says: 'Whatever [sin has been committed] in the village, whatever in the forest,' / he averts Varuṇa just as has been stated. / The Āhavanīya fire has the sacrificer as its deity,

1.6.5.s: bhrātṛvyadevatyo dakṣiṇaḥ | yadāhavanīye juhuyāt | yajamānaṃ varuṇapāśena grāhayet | dakṣiṇe'gnau juhoti | bhrātṛvyameva varuṇapāśena grāhayati | śūrpeṇa juhoti | annyameva varuṇamavayajate | śīrṣannadhi nidhāya juhoti | śīrṣata eva varuṇamavayajate | pratyaṅktiṣṭhañjuhoti
1.6.5.d: भ्रातृव्यदेवत्यो दक्षिणः । यदाहवनीये जुहुयात् । यजमानं वरुणपाशेन ग्राहयेत् । दक्षिणेऽग्नौ जुहोति । भ्रातृव्यमेव वरुणपाशेन ग्राहयति । शूर्पेण जुहोति । अन्न्यमेव वरुणमवयजते । शीर्षन्नधि निधाय जुहोति । शीर्षत एव वरुणमवयजते । प्रत्यङ्क्तिष्ठञ्जुहोति
1.6.5.m: the southern [fire] has the rival as its deity. / If he were to offer in the Āhavanīya fire, / he would cause the sacrificer to be seized by the noose of Varuṇa. / He offers in the southern fire; / he causes the rival to be seized by the noose of Varuṇa. / He offers with a winnowing fan; / he averts another Varuṇa. / Placing [it] on his head, he offers; / he averts Varuṇa from the head. / Standing facing west, he offers. // [This section of four corners, through an error in line-break or stroke-division, has become eight lines.]

1.6.5.s: pratyaṅṅeva varuṇapāśānnirmucyate | akrankarma karmakṛta ityāha | devānṛṇaṃ niravadāya | anṛṇā gṛhānupapreteti vāvaitadāha | varuṇagṛhītaṃ vā etadyajñasya | yadyajuṣā gṛhītasyātiricyate | tuṣāśca niṣkāsaśca | tuṣaiśca niṣkāsena cāvabhṛthamavaiti | varuṇagṛhītenaiva varuṇamavayajate | apo'vabhṛthamavaiti
1.6.5.d: प्रत्यङ्ङेव वरुणपाशान्निर्मुच्यते । अक्रन्कर्म कर्मकृत इत्याह । देवानृणं निरवदाय । अनृणा गृहानुपप्रेतेति वावैतदाह । वरुणगृहीतं वा एतद्यज्ञस्य । यद्यजुषा गृहीतस्यातिरिच्यते । तुषाश्च निष्कासश्च । तुषैश्च निष्कासेन चावभृथमवैति । वरुणगृहीतेनैव वरुणमवयजते । अपोऽवभृथमवैति
1.6.5.m: Facing west, he is released from the noose of Varuṇa. / 'The workers have done the work,' he says. / Having paid the debt to the gods, / 'Enter the houses free from debt,' is what he says. / What remains of that which was taken with a yajus, / is seized by Varuṇa for the sacrifice: / the husks and the scraping [of dough]. / With the husks and the scraping he goes down to the purificatory bath. / With what is seized by Varuṇa he averts Varuṇa. / He goes down to the water for the purificatory bath.

1.6.5.s: apsu vai varuṇaḥ | sākṣādeva varuṇamava yajate | pratiyuto varuṇasya pāśa ityāha | varuṇapāśādeva nirmucyate | apratīkṣamāyanti | varuṇasyāntarhityai | edho'syedhiṣīmahītyāha | samidhaivāgniṃ namasyanta upāyanti | tejosi tejo mayi dhehītyāha | teja evātmandhatte
1.6.5.d: अप्सु वै वरुणः । साक्षादेव वरुणमव यजते । प्रतियुतो वरुणस्य पाश इत्याह । वरुणपाशादेव निर्मुच्यते । अप्रतीक्षमायन्ति । वरुणस्यान्तर्हित्यै । एधोऽस्येधिषीमहीत्याह । समिधैवाग्निं नमस्यन्त उपायन्ति । तेजोसि तेजो मयि धेहीत्याह । तेज एवात्मन्धत्ते
1.6.5.m: Varuṇa is in the waters. / Directly he averts Varuṇa. / 'Unloosed is the noose of Varuṇa,' he says. / From the noose of Varuṇa he is released. / They return without looking back, / for the concealing of Varuṇa. / 'Thou art kindling; may we kindle thee,' he says. / Reverencing Agni with a kindling stick, they approach. / 'Thou art fiery energy; place fiery energy in me,' he says. / Fiery energy he places in himself.

1.6.6.s: devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | so'gnirabravīt | mameyamanīkavatī tanūḥ | tāṃ prīṇīta | athāsurānabhi bhaviṣyatheti | te devā agnaye'nīkavate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ niravapan | so'gniranīkavānthsvena bhāgadheyena prītaḥ | caturdhā'nīkānyajanayata | tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ
1.6.6.d: देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । सोऽग्निरब्रवीत् । ममेयमनीकवती तनूः । तां प्रीणीत । अथासुरानभि भविष्यथेति । ते देवा अग्नयेऽनीकवते पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निरवपन् । सोऽग्निरनीकवान्थ्स्वेन भागधेयेन प्रीतः । चतुर्धाऽनीकान्यजनयत । ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः
1.6.6.m: The gods and the asuras were in conflict. / Agni said: / 'This is my sharp-fronted form. / Please it, / and then you will overcome the asuras.' / Those gods poured out an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni the sharp-fronted. / Agni the sharp-fronted, pleased with his own share, / brought forth vanguard forces fourfold. / Thereupon the gods prospered, / the asuras were defeated.

1.6.6.s: yadagnaye'nīkavate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | agnimevānīkavantaṃ svena bhāgadheyena prīṇāti | so'gniranīkavānthsvena bhāgadheyena prītaḥ | caturdhā'nīkāni janayate | asau vā ādityo'gniranīkavān | tasya raśmayo'nīkāni | sākaṃ sūryeṇodyatā nirvapati | sākṣādevāsmā anīkāni janayati | te'surāḥ parājitā yantaḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī upāśrayan
1.6.6.d: यदग्नयेऽनीकवते पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निर्वपति । अग्निमेवानीकवन्तं स्वेन भागधेयेन प्रीणाति । सोऽग्निरनीकवान्थ्स्वेन भागधेयेन प्रीतः । चतुर्धाऽनीकानि जनयते । असौ वा आदित्योऽग्निरनीकवान् । तस्य रश्मयोऽनीकानि । साकं सूर्येणोद्यता निर्वपति । साक्षादेवास्मा अनीकानि जनयति । तेऽसुराः पराजिता यन्तः । द्यावापृथिवी उपाश्रयन्
1.6.6.m: When he pours out an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni the sharp-fronted, / he pleases Agni the sharp-fronted with his own share. / Agni the sharp-fronted, pleased with his own share, / brings forth vanguard forces fourfold. / That yonder sun, indeed, is Agni the sharp-fronted. / His rays are the vanguard forces. / Along with the rising sun he pours out [the offering]. / Directly he brings forth vanguard forces for him. / Those asuras, having been defeated, / took refuge in heaven and earth.

1.6.6.s: te devā marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyaścaruṃ niravapan | tāndyāvāpṛthivībhyāmevobhayataḥ samatapan | yanmarudbhyaḥ sāntapanebhyaścaruṃ nirvapati | dyāvāpṛthivībhyāmeva tadubhayato yajamāno bhrātṛvyānthsaṃtapati | madhyandine nirvapati | tarhi hi te'kṣṇiṣṭhaṃ tapati | carurbhavati | sarvata evainānthsaṃtapati | te devāḥ śvovijayinaḥ santaḥ | sarvāsāṃ dugdhe gṛhamedhīyaṃ caruṃ niravapan
1.6.6.d: ते देवा मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्यश्चरुं निरवपन् । तान्द्यावापृथिवीभ्यामेवोभयतः समतपन् । यन्मरुद्भ्यः सान्तपनेभ्यश्चरुं निर्वपति । द्यावापृथिवीभ्यामेव तदुभयतो यजमानो भ्रातृव्यान्थ्संतपति । मध्यन्दिने निर्वपति । तर्हि हि तेऽक्ष्णिष्ठं तपति । चरुर्भवति । सर्वत एवैनान्थ्संतपति । ते देवाः श्वोविजयिनः सन्तः । सर्वासां दुग्धे गृहमेधीयं चरुं निरवपन्
1.6.6.m: Those gods poured out a mess of boiled rice for the scorching Maruts. / They scorched them from both heaven and earth. / When he pours out a mess of boiled rice for the scorching Maruts, / from both heaven and earth the sacrificer scorches his rivals. / At midday he pours it out; / for then it burns hottest in the eye. / It is a mess of boiled rice; / from all sides he scorches them. / Those gods, being victorious on the morrow, / poured out a mess of boiled rice for the domestic rite from the milk of all [the cows].

1.6.6.s: āśitā evādyopavasāma | kasya vā'hedam | kasya vā śvo bhaviteti | sa śṛto'bhavat | tasyāhutasya nāśnann | na hi devā ahutasyāśnanti | te'bruvan | kasmā imaṃ hoṣyāma iti | marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhya ityabruvan | taṃ marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo'juhavuḥ
1.6.6.d: आशिता एवाद्योपवसाम । कस्य वाऽहेदम् । कस्य वा श्वो भवितेति । स शृतोऽभवत् । तस्याहुतस्य नाश्नन्न् । न हि देवा अहुतस्याश्नन्ति । तेऽब्रुवन् । कस्मा इमं होष्याम इति । मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्य इत्यब्रुवन् । तं मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्योऽजुहवुः
1.6.6.m: 'Having eaten, let us fast today! / Whose [will this world] be, / or whose will it be tomorrow?' / It became cooked. / When it was not offered, they did not eat of it, / for the gods do not eat of what is unoffered. / They said: / 'To whom shall we offer this?' / 'To the domestic Maruts,' they said. / They offered it to the domestic Maruts.

1.6.6.s: tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo gṛhe juhvati | bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | yadvai yajñasya pākatrā kriyate | paśavyaṃ tat | pākatrā vā etatkriyate | yannedhmā barhirbhavati | na sāmidhenīranvāha
1.6.6.d: ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः । यस्यैवं विदुषो मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यो गृहे जुह्वति । भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति । यद्वै यज्ञस्य पाकत्रा क्रियते । पशव्यं तत् । पाकत्रा वा एतत्क्रियते । यन्नेध्मा बर्हिर्भवति । न सामिधेनीरन्वाह
1.6.6.m: Thereupon the gods prospered, / the asuras were defeated. / In the house of him who knows this, they offer to the domestic Maruts; / he prospers in himself, / his rival is defeated. / Whatever is done in a simple manner in the sacrifice, / that is conducive to domestic animals. / In a simple manner, indeed, is this done, / in that there is no kindling-wood and sacred grass, / nor does he recite the kindling verses.

1.6.6.s: na prayājā ijyante | nānūyājāḥ | ya evaṃ veda | paśumānbhavati | ājyabhāgau yajati | yajñasyaiva cakṣuṣī nāntareti | maruto gṛhamedhino yajati | bhāgadheyenaivainānthsamardhayati | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati pratiṣṭhityai | iḍānto bhavati | paśavo vā iḍā | paśuṣvevopariṣṭātpratitiṣṭhati
1.6.6.d: न प्रयाजा इज्यन्ते । नानूयाजाः । य एवं वेद । पशुमान्भवति । आज्यभागौ यजति । यज्ञस्यैव चक्षुषी नान्तरेति । मरुतो गृहमेधिनो यजति । भागधेयेनैवैनान्थ्समर्धयति । अग्निं स्विष्टकृतं यजति प्रतिष्ठित्यै । इडान्तो भवति । पशवो वा इडा । पशुष्वेवोपरिष्टात्प्रतितिष्ठति
1.6.6.m: Fore-sacrifices are not offered, / nor after-sacrifices. / Whosoever knows thus / becomes possessed of domestic animals. / He offers the two portions of clarified butter; / he does not omit the two eyes of the sacrifice. / He sacrifices to the domestic Maruts; / he makes them prosper with their share. / He sacrifices to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt for stability. / It ends with the iḍā. / The iḍā is domestic animals; / upon domestic animals he firmly stands from above.

1.6.7.s: yatpatnī gṛhamedhīyasyāśnīyāt | gṛhamedhyeva syāt | vi tvasya yajña ṛdhyeta | yannāśnīyāt | agṛhamedhī syāt | nāsya yajño vyṛddhyeta | prativeśaṃ paceyuḥ | tasyāśnīyāt | gṛhamedhyeva bhavati | nāsya yajño vyṛddhyate
1.6.7.d: यत्पत्नी गृहमेधीयस्याश्नीयात् । गृहमेध्येव स्यात् । वि त्वस्य यज्ञ ऋध्येत । यन्नाश्नीयात् । अगृहमेधी स्यात् । नास्य यज्ञो व्यृद्ध्येत । प्रतिवेशं पचेयुः । तस्याश्नीयात् । गृहमेध्येव भवति । नास्य यज्ञो व्यृद्ध्यते
1.6.7.m: If the wife were to eat of the Gṛhamedhīya offering, / she would be performing the domestic sacrifice, / but his sacrifice would fail. / If she were not to eat, / she would not be performing the domestic sacrifice, / [yet] his sacrifice would not fail. / They should cook [food] for a neighbor; / she should eat of that. / She indeed performs the domestic sacrifice, / [and] his sacrifice does not fail.

1.6.7.s: te devā gṛhamedhīyeneṣṭvā | āśitā abhavan | āñjatābhyañjata | anuvathsānavāsayan | tebhyo'surāḥ kṣudhaṃ prāhiṇvan | sā deveṣu lokamavittvā | asurānpunaragacchat | gṛhamedhīyeneṣṭvā | āśitā bhavanti | āñjate'bhyañjate
1.6.7.d: ते देवा गृहमेधीयेनेष्ट्वा । आशिता अभवन् । आञ्जताभ्यञ्जत । अनुवथ्सानवासयन् । तेभ्योऽसुराः क्षुधं प्राहिण्वन् । सा देवेषु लोकमवित्त्वा । असुरान्पुनरगच्छत् । गृहमेधीयेनेष्ट्वा । आशिता भवन्ति । आञ्जतेऽभ्यञ्जते
1.6.7.m: Those gods, having sacrificed with the Gṛhamedhīya, / became sated; / they anointed their eyes and limbs; / they let the calves go to [the cows]. / To them the asuras dispatched hunger. / That [hunger], not finding a place among the gods, / went back to the asuras. / Having sacrificed with the Gṛhamedhīya, / they become sated; / they anoint their eyes and limbs;

1.6.7.s: anuvathsān vāsayanti | bhrātṛvyāyaiva tadyajamānaḥ kṣudhaṃ prahiṇoti | te devā gṛhamedhīyeneṣṭvā | indrāya niṣkāsaṃ nyadadhuḥ | asmāneva śva indro nihitabhāga upāvartiteti | tānindro nihitabhāga upāvartata | gṛhamedhīyeneṣṭvā | indrāya niṣkāsaṃ nidadhyāt | indra evainaṃ nihitabhāga upāvartate | gārhapatye juhoti
1.6.7.d: अनुवथ्सान् वासयन्ति । भ्रातृव्यायैव तद्यजमानः क्षुधं प्रहिणोति । ते देवा गृहमेधीयेनेष्ट्वा । इन्द्राय निष्कासं न्यदधुः । अस्मानेव श्व इन्द्रो निहितभाग उपावर्तितेति । तानिन्द्रो निहितभाग उपावर्तत । गृहमेधीयेनेष्ट्वा । इन्द्राय निष्कासं निदध्यात् । इन्द्र एवैनं निहितभाग उपावर्तते । गार्हपत्ये जुहोति
1.6.7.m: they let the calves go to [the cows]. / The sacrificer thereby dispatches hunger to his rival. / Those gods, having sacrificed with the Gṛhamedhīya, / set aside the scraping for Indra, / [saying,] "Indra, having his portion set aside, will turn back to us tomorrow." / To them Indra turned back, having his portion set aside. / Having sacrificed with the Gṛhamedhīya, / he should set aside the scraping for Indra. / Indra indeed turns back to him, having his portion set aside. / He offers it in the Gārhapatya [fire].

1.6.7.s: bhāgadheyenaivainaṃ samardhayati | ṛṣabhamāhvayati | vaṣaṭkāra evāsya saḥ | atho indriyameva tadvīryaṃ yajamāno bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte | indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | parāṃ parāvatamagacchat | apārādhamiti manyamānaḥ | so'bravīt | ka idaṃ vediṣyatīti | te'bruvanmaruto varaṃ vṛṇāmahai
1.6.7.d: भागधेयेनैवैनं समर्धयति । ऋषभमाह्वयति । वषट्कार एवास्य सः । अथो इन्द्रियमेव तद्वीर्यं यजमानो भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते । इन्द्रो वृत्रं हत्वा । परां परावतमगच्छत् । अपाराधमिति मन्यमानः । सोऽब्रवीत् । क इदं वेदिष्यतीति । तेऽब्रुवन्मरुतो वरं वृणामहै
1.6.7.m: He satisfies him with his own share. / He calls out to a bull; / that is verily his vaṣaṭ-call. / Moreover, the sacrificer thereby strips away the rival's sensual power and heroic power. / Indra, having slain Vṛtra, / went to the farthest distance, / thinking, "I have committed a fault." / He said, / "Who will find out about this?" / The Maruts said, "Let us choose a boon:

1.6.7.s: atha vayaṃ vedāma | asmabhyameva prathamaṃ havirnirupyātā iti | ta enamadhyakrīḍan | tatkrīḍināṃ krīḍitvam | yanmarudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ prathamaṃ havirnirupyate vijityai | sākaṃ sūryeṇodyatā nirvapati | etasminvai loka indro vṛtramahanthsamṛddhyai | etadbrāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi | etadbrāhmaṇa aindrāgnaḥ | athaiṣa aindraścarurbhavati |
1.6.7.d: अथ वयं वेदाम । अस्मभ्यमेव प्रथमं हविर्निरुप्याता इति । त एनमध्यक्रीडन् । तत्क्रीडिनां क्रीडित्वम् । यन्मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः प्रथमं हविर्निरुप्यते विजित्यै । साकं सूर्येणोद्यता निर्वपति । एतस्मिन्वै लोक इन्द्रो वृत्रमहन्थ्समृद्ध्यै । एतद्ब्राह्मणान्येव पञ्च हवींषि । एतद्ब्राह्मण ऐन्द्राग्नः । अथैष ऐन्द्रश्चरुर्भवति ।
1.6.7.m: Then we will find out: / let the first oblation be poured out for us." / They gamboled over him; / that is the sportiveness of the sportive ones (Krīḍins). / That the first oblation is poured out for the sportive Maruts is for victory. / He pours it out together with the rising sun; / in this realm Indra slew Vṛtra; [it is] for success. / These five oblations have the same Brāhmaṇa [exegesis]; / the one to Indra and Agni has this [same] Brāhmaṇa. / Then this mess of boiled rice for Indra is [prepared]. / Indra took up this selected share / having slain Vṛtra, / over and above the other deities. / When this mess of boiled rice for Indra is [prepared], / the sacrificer takes up that selected share / over and above the other creatures. / There is a cake on one potsherd for Viśvakarman; / by that the sacrificer secures all ritual acts.

1.6.7.s: uddhāraṃ vā etamindra udaharata | vṛtraṃ hatvā | anyāsu devatāsvadhi | yadeṣa aindraścarurbhavati | uddhārameva taṃ yajamāna uddharate | anyāsu prajāsvadhi | vaiśvakarmaṇa ekakapālo bhavati | viśvānyeva tena karmāṇi yajamāno'varundhe
1.6.7.d: उद्धारं वा एतमिन्द्र उदहरत । वृत्रं हत्वा । अन्यासु देवतास्वधि । यदेष ऐन्द्रश्चरुर्भवति । उद्धारमेव तं यजमान उद्धरते । अन्यासु प्रजास्वधि । वैश्वकर्मण एककपालो भवति । विश्वान्येव तेन कर्माणि यजमानोऽवरुन्धे

1.6.8.s: vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā varuṇapraghāsairvaruṇapāśādamuñcat | sākamedhaiḥ pratyasthāpayat | tryambakai rudraṃ niravādayata | pitṛyajñena suvargaṃ lokamagamayat | yadvaiśvadevena yajate | prajā eva tadyajamānaḥ sṛjate | tā varuṇapraghāsairvaruṇapāśānmuñcati | sākamedhaiḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati | tryambakai rudraṃ niravadayate
1.6.8.d: वैश्वदेवेन वै प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ता वरुणप्रघासैर्वरुणपाशादमुञ्चत् । साकमेधैः प्रत्यस्थापयत् । त्र्यम्बकै रुद्रं निरवादयत । पितृयज्ञेन सुवर्गं लोकमगमयत् । यद्वैश्वदेवेन यजते । प्रजा एव तद्यजमानः सृजते । ता वरुणप्रघासैर्वरुणपाशान्मुञ्चति । साकमेधैः प्रतिष्ठापयति । त्र्यम्बकै रुद्रं निरवदयते
1.6.8.m: By means of the Vaiśvadeva, Prajāpati created offspring; / by the Varuṇapraghāsas he released them from the noose of Varuṇa; / by the Sākamedhas he established them firmly; / by the Tryambakas he appeased Rudra; / by the Pitṛyajña he made them reach the heavenly realm. / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / the sacrificer creates offspring; / by the Varuṇapraghāsas he releases them from the noose of Varuṇa; / by the Sākamedhas he establishes them firmly; / by the Tryambakas he appeases Rudra;

1.6.8.s: pitṛyajñena suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnāvītī nirvapati | dakṣiṇāvṛddhi pitṛṇām | anādṛtya tat | uttarata evopavīya nirvapet | ubhaye hi devāśca pitaraścejyante | atho yadeva dakṣiṇārdhe'dhi śrayati | tena dakṣiṇāvṛt | somāya pitṛmate puroḍāśaṃ ṣaṭkapālaṃ nirvapati | saṃvathsaro vai somaḥ pitṛmān
1.6.8.d: पितृयज्ञेन सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति । दक्षिणतः प्राचीनावीती निर्वपति । दक्षिणावृद्धि पितृणाम् । अनादृत्य तत् । उत्तरत एवोपवीय निर्वपेत् । उभये हि देवाश्च पितरश्चेज्यन्ते । अथो यदेव दक्षिणार्धेऽधि श्रयति । तेन दक्षिणावृत् । सोमाय पितृमते पुरोडाशं षट्कपालं निर्वपति । संवथ्सरो वै सोमः पितृमान्
1.6.8.m: by the Pitṛyajña he makes them reach the heavenly realm. / He pours out [the oblations] on the south, with the sacrificial cord over the right shoulder; / for the south is the direction of the fathers. / Disregarding that, / he should pour them out having the cord over the left shoulder, on the north; / for both the gods and the fathers are sacrificed to. / Moreover, because he places [the vessel] on the southern half, / thereby it is turned toward the south. / He pours out a cake on six potsherds for Soma accompanied by the fathers; / Soma accompanied by the fathers is the year;

1.6.8.s: saṃvathsarameva prīṇāti | pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo dhānāḥ | māsā vai pitaro barhiṣadaḥ | māsāneva prīṇāti | yasminvā ṛtau puruṣaḥ pramīyate | so'syāmuṣmiṃ lloke bhavati | bahurūpā dhānā bhavanti | ahorātrāṇāmabhijityai | pitṛbhyo'gniṣvāttebhyo mantham | ardhamāsā vai pitaro'gniṣvāttāḥ
1.6.8.d: संवथ्सरमेव प्रीणाति । पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो धानाः । मासा वै पितरो बर्हिषदः । मासानेव प्रीणाति । यस्मिन्वा ऋतौ पुरुषः प्रमीयते । सोऽस्यामुष्मिं ल्लोके भवति । बहुरूपा धाना भवन्ति । अहोरात्राणामभिजित्यै । पितृभ्योऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो मन्थम् । अर्धमासा वै पितरोऽग्निष्वात्ताः
1.6.8.m: he satisfies the year itself. / Parched grains for the fathers seated on the sacrificial grass; / the months are the fathers seated on the sacrificial grass; / he satisfies the months themselves. / In whatever season a man dies, / that [season] belongs to him in yonder world. / The parched grains are of various colors, / for the conquest of the days and nights. / A stirred drink for the fathers consumed by fire; / the half-months are the fathers consumed by fire;

1.6.8.s: ardhamāsāneva prīṇāti | abhivānyāyai dugdhe bhavati | sā hi pitṛdevatyaṃ duhe | yatpūrṇam | tanmanuṣyāṇām | uparyardho devānām | ardhaḥ pitṛṇām | ardha upamanthati | ardho hi pitṛṇām | ekayopamanthati
1.6.8.d: अर्धमासानेव प्रीणाति । अभिवान्यायै दुग्धे भवति । सा हि पितृदेवत्यं दुहे । यत्पूर्णम् । तन्मनुष्याणाम् । उपर्यर्धो देवानाम् । अर्धः पितृणाम् । अर्ध उपमन्थति । अर्धो हि पितृणाम् । एकयोपमन्थति
1.6.8.m: he satisfies the half-months themselves. / It is in milk from a cow whose calf is adopted; / for she yields milk sacred to the fathers. / What is full, / that belongs to humans; / the upper half belongs to the gods; / a half belongs to the fathers. / He stirs it halfway; / for half belongs to the fathers. / He stirs it with one [stirring stick];

1.6.8.s: ekā hi pitṛṇām | dakṣiṇopamanthati | dakṣiṇāvṛddhi pitṛṇām | anārabhyopamanthati | taddhi pitṝngacchati | imāṃ diśaṃ vedimuddhanti | ubhaye hi devāśca pitaraścejyante | catuḥsraktirbhavati | sarvā hyanu diśaḥ pitaraḥ | akhātā bhavati ||
1.6.8.d: एका हि पितृणाम् । दक्षिणोपमन्थति । दक्षिणावृद्धि पितृणाम् । अनारभ्योपमन्थति । तद्धि पितॄन्गच्छति । इमां दिशं वेदिमुद्धन्ति । उभये हि देवाश्च पितरश्चेज्यन्ते । चतुःस्रक्तिर्भवति । सर्वा ह्यनु दिशः पितरः । अखाता भवति ॥

1.6.8.s: khātā hi devānām | madhyato'gnirādhīyate | antato hi devānāmādhīyate | varṣīyānidhma idhmādbhavati vyāvṛttyai | pari śrayati | antarhito hi pitṛloko manuṣyalokāt | yatparuṣi dinam | taddevānām | yadantarā | tanmanuṣyāṇām
1.6.8.d: खाता हि देवानाम् । मध्यतोऽग्निराधीयते । अन्ततो हि देवानामाधीयते । वर्षीयानिध्म इध्माद्भवति व्यावृत्त्यै । परि श्रयति । अन्तर्हितो हि पितृलोको मनुष्यलोकात् । यत्परुषि दिनम् । तद्देवानाम् । यदन्तरा । तन्मनुष्याणाम्
1.6.8.m: for that of the gods is excavated. / The fire is placed in the middle; / for that of the gods is placed at the edge. / The kindling wood is larger than [ordinary] kindling wood, for distinction. / He encloses it; / for the world of the fathers is hidden from the world of men. / What is cut at the joint, / that belongs to the gods; / what is between, / that belongs to humans;

1.6.8.s: yathsamūlam | tatpitṛṇām | samūlaṃ barhirbhavati vyāvṛttyai | dakṣiṇā stṛṇāti | dakṣiṇāvṛddhi pitṛṇām | triḥ paryeti | tṛtīye vā ito loke pitaraḥ | tāneva prīṇāti | triḥ punaḥ paryeti | ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante
1.6.8.d: यथ्समूलम् । तत्पितृणाम् । समूलं बर्हिर्भवति व्यावृत्त्यै । दक्षिणा स्तृणाति । दक्षिणावृद्धि पितृणाम् । त्रिः पर्येति । तृतीये वा इतो लोके पितरः । तानेव प्रीणाति । त्रिः पुनः पर्येति । षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते
1.6.8.m: what is with the root, / that belongs to the fathers. / The sacrificial grass is with its root, for distinction. / He spreads it toward the south; / for the south is the direction of the fathers. / He walks around three times; / for the fathers are in the third world from here; / he satisfies them. / He walks around three times again; / they amount to six;

1.6.8.s: ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūneva prīṇāti | yatprastaraṃ yajuṣā gṛhṇīyāt | pramāyuko yajamānaḥ syāt | yanna gṛhṇīyāt | anāyatanaḥ syāt | tūṣṇīmeva nyasyet | na pramāyuko bhavati | nānāyatanaḥ | yattrīnparidhīnparidadhyāt
1.6.8.d: षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतूनेव प्रीणाति । यत्प्रस्तरं यजुषा गृह्णीयात् । प्रमायुको यजमानः स्यात् । यन्न गृह्णीयात् । अनायतनः स्यात् । तूष्णीमेव न्यस्येत् । न प्रमायुको भवति । नानायतनः । यत्त्रीन्परिधीन्परिदध्यात्
1.6.8.m: for there are six seasons; / he satisfies the seasons themselves. / If he were to take the grass-bundle (prastara) with a yajus, / the sacrificer would be liable to die; / if he were not to take it, / he would be without a foundation; / he should cast it down silently; / he does not become liable to die, / nor without a foundation. / If he were to lay down three enclosing sticks,

1.6.8.s: mṛtyunā yajamānaṃ parigṛhṇīyāt | yanna paridadhyāt | rakṣāṃsi yajñaṃ hanyuḥ | dvau paridhī paridadhāti | rakṣasāmapahatyai | atho mṛtyoreva yajamānamuthsṛjati | yattrīṇi trīṇi havīgṣyudāhareyuḥ | trayastraya eṣāṃ sākaṃ pramīyeran | ekaikamanūcīnānyudāharanti | ekaika evaiṣāmanvañcaḥ pramīyate | kaśipu kaśipavyāya | upabarhaṇamupabarhaṇyāya | āñjanamāñjanyāya | abhyañjanamabhyañjanyāya | yathābhāgamevainānprīṇāti
1.6.8.d: मृत्युना यजमानं परिगृह्णीयात् । यन्न परिदध्यात् । रक्षांसि यज्ञं हन्युः । द्वौ परिधी परिदधाति । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अथो मृत्योरेव यजमानमुथ्सृजति । यत्त्रीणि त्रीणि हवीग्ष्युदाहरेयुः । त्रयस्त्रय एषां साकं प्रमीयेरन् । एकैकमनूचीनान्युदाहरन्ति । एकैक एवैषामन्वञ्चः प्रमीयते । कशिपु कशिपव्याय । उपबर्हणमुपबर्हण्याय । आञ्जनमाञ्जन्याय । अभ्यञ्जनमभ्यञ्जन्याय । यथाभागमेवैनान्प्रीणाति
1.6.8.m: he would enclose the sacrificer with death; / if he were not to lay them down, / the rakṣases would strike the sacrifice; / he lays down two enclosing sticks, / for driving away the rakṣases; / and he releases the sacrificer from death. / If they were to bring out three oblations at a time, / three by three of them would die together; / they bring them out one by one in succession; / one by one following another of them dies. / A mat for one deserving a mat; / a pillow for one deserving a pillow; / eye-salve for one deserving eye-salve; / body-salve for one deserving body-salve: / according to their share he satisfies them.

1.6.9.s: agnaye devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ samidhyamānāyānu brūhītyāha | ubhaye hi devāśca pitaraścejyante | ekāmanvāha | ekā hi pitṛṇām | triranvāha | trirhi devānām | āghārāvāghārayati | yajñaparuṣoranantarityai | nārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte | na hotāram
1.6.9.d: अग्नये देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः समिध्यमानायानु ब्रूहीत्याह । उभये हि देवाश्च पितरश्चेज्यन्ते । एकामन्वाह । एका हि पितृणाम् । त्रिरन्वाह । त्रिर्हि देवानाम् । आघारावाघारयति । यज्ञपरुषोरनन्तरित्यै । नार्षेयं वृणीते । न होतारम्
1.6.9.m: He says: 'Recite [the introductory mantra] for Agni being kindled for the gods, for the Fathers.' / For both the gods and the Fathers are sacrificed to. / He recites once. / For one is of the Fathers. / He recites three times. / For three is of the gods. / He pours the two libations of butter, / so that the two joints of the sacrifice are not separated. / He does not select the lineage of ṛṣis, / nor [does he select] the Hotṛ.

1.6.9.s: yadārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīta | yaddhotāram | pramāyuko yajamānaḥ syāt | pramāyuko hotā | tasmānna vṛṇīte | yajamānasya hoturgopīthāya | apa barhiṣaḥ prayājān yajati | prajā vai barhiḥ | prajā eva mṛtyoruthsṛjati | ājyabhāgau yajati
1.6.9.d: यदार्षेयं वृणीत । यद्धोतारम् । प्रमायुको यजमानः स्यात् । प्रमायुको होता । तस्मान्न वृणीते । यजमानस्य होतुर्गोपीथाय । अप बर्हिषः प्रयाजान् यजति । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । प्रजा एव मृत्योरुथ्सृजति । आज्यभागौ यजति
1.6.9.m: If he were to select the lineage of ṛṣis, / if [he were to select] the Hotṛ, / the sacrificer would be prone to die; / the Hotṛ would be prone to die. / Therefore he does not select, / for the protection of the sacrificer [and] of the Hotṛ. / He offers the fore-offerings without sacred grass. / The sacred grass is offspring. / He delivers the offspring from death. / He offers the two portions of clarified butter.

1.6.9.s: yajñasyaiva cakṣuṣī nāntareti | prācīnāvītī somaṃ yajati | pitṛdevatyā hi | eṣā''hutiḥ | pañcakṛtvo'vadyati | pañca hyetā devatāḥ | dve puro'nuvākye | yājyā devatā vaṣaṭkāraḥ | tā eva prīṇāti | santatamavadyati
1.6.9.d: यज्ञस्यैव चक्षुषी नान्तरेति । प्राचीनावीती सोमं यजति । पितृदेवत्या हि । एषा'ऽहुतिः । पञ्चकृत्वोऽवद्यति । पञ्च ह्येता देवताः । द्वे पुरोऽनुवाक्ये । याज्या देवता वषट्कारः । ता एव प्रीणाति । सन्ततमवद्यति
1.6.9.m: He does not omit the two eyes of the sacrifice. / Wearing his sacred thread over the right shoulder, he sacrifices to Soma, / for this offering belongs to the Fathers. / He cuts off [portions] five times, / for these deities are five: / two introductory verses, / the offering verse, the deity, [and] the vaṣaṭ-call. / Those very [deities] he pleases. / He cuts off continuously,

1.6.9.s: ṛtūnāṃ saṃtatyai | praivaibhyaḥ pūrvayā puro'nuvākyayā''ha | praṇayati dvitīyayā | gamayati yājyayā | tṛtīye vā ito loke pitaraḥ | ahna evainān pūrvayā puro'nuvākyayā'tyānayati | rātriyai dvitīyayā | aivainān yājyayā gamayati | dakṣiṇato'vadāya | udaṅṅatikrāmati vyāvṛttyai
1.6.9.d: ऋतूनां संतत्यै । प्रैवैभ्यः पूर्वया पुरोऽनुवाक्यया'ऽह । प्रणयति द्वितीयया । गमयति याज्यया । तृतीये वा इतो लोके पितरः । अह्न एवैनान् पूर्वया पुरोऽनुवाक्ययाऽत्यानयति । रात्रियै द्वितीयया । ऐवैनान् याज्यया गमयति । दक्षिणतोऽवदाय । उदङ्ङतिक्रामति व्यावृत्त्यै
1.6.9.m: for the continuity of the seasons. / With the first introductory verse he announces to them; / with the second he brings [them] forward; / with the offering verse he makes [them] arrive. / The Fathers are indeed in the third world from here. / With the first introductory verse he brings them across the day; / with the second, [across] the night; / with the offering verse he makes them arrive. / Having cut off [the portions] on the south, / he steps across towards the north for separation.

1.6.9.s: āsvadhetyāśrāvayati | astu svadheti pratyāśrāvayati | svadhā nama iti vaṣaṭkaroti | svadhākāro hi pitṛṇām | somamagre yajati | somaprayājā hi pitaraḥ | somaṃ pitṛmantaṃ yajati | saṃvathsaro vai somaḥ pitṛmān | saṃvathsarameva tadyajati | pitṝnbarhiṣado yajati
1.6.9.d: आस्वधेत्याश्रावयति । अस्तु स्वधेति प्रत्याश्रावयति । स्वधा नम इति वषट्करोति । स्वधाकारो हि पितृणाम् । सोममग्रे यजति । सोमप्रयाजा हि पितरः । सोमं पितृमन्तं यजति । संवथ्सरो वै सोमः पितृमान् । संवथ्सरमेव तद्यजति । पितॄन्बर्हिषदो यजति

1.6.9.s: ye vai yajvānaḥ | te pitaro barhiṣadaḥ | tāneva tadyajati | pitṝnagniṣvāttān yajati | ye vā ayajvāno gṛhamedhinaḥ | te pitaro'gniṣvāttāḥ | tāneva tadyajati | agniṃ kavyavāhanaṃ yajati | ya eva pitṛṇāmagniḥ | tameva tadyajati
1.6.9.d: ये वै यज्वानः । ते पितरो बर्हिषदः । तानेव तद्यजति । पितॄनग्निष्वात्तान् यजति । ये वा अयज्वानो गृहमेधिनः । ते पितरोऽग्निष्वात्ताः । तानेव तद्यजति । अग्निं कव्यवाहनं यजति । य एव पितृणामग्निः । तमेव तद्यजति

1.6.9.s: atho yathā'gniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati | tādṛgeva tat | etatte tata ye ca tvāmanviti tisṛṣu sraktīṣu nidadhāti | tasmādā tṛtīyātpuruṣānnāma na gṛhṇanti | etāvanto hījyante | atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvamityāha | hlīkā hi pitaraḥ | udañco niṣkrāmanti | eṣā vai manuṣyāṇāṃ dik | svāmeva taddiśamanu niṣkrāmanti
1.6.9.d: अथो यथाऽग्निं स्विष्टकृतं यजति । तादृगेव तत् । एतत्ते तत ये च त्वामन्विति तिसृषु स्रक्तीषु निदधाति । तस्मादा तृतीयात्पुरुषान्नाम न गृह्णन्ति । एतावन्तो हीज्यन्ते । अत्र पितरो यथाभागं मन्दध्वमित्याह । ह्लीका हि पितरः । उदञ्चो निष्क्रामन्ति । एषा वै मनुष्याणां दिक् । स्वामेव तद्दिशमनु निष्क्रामन्ति
1.6.9.m: And just as he sacrifices to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, / such indeed is that. / He places [them] down on three corners with: 'This for you, father, and for those who follow you.' / Therefore they recite the names [of ancestors] down to the third generation; / for only that many are sacrificed to. / He says: 'Here, O Fathers, gladden yourselves, each according to his share!' / For the Fathers are modest. / They walk out towards the north. / That is the direction of men. / It is towards their own direction that they walk out.

1.6.9.s: āhavanīyamupatiṣṭhante | nyevāsmai taddhnuvate | yathsatyāhavanīye | athānyatra caranti | ātamitorupatiṣṭhante | agnimevopadraṣṭāraṃ kṛtvā | pitṝnniravadayante | antaṃ vā ete prāṇānāṃ gacchanti | ya ātamitorupa tiṣṭhante | susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayamityāha
1.6.9.d: आहवनीयमुपतिष्ठन्ते । न्येवास्मै तद्ध्नुवते । यथ्सत्याहवनीये । अथान्यत्र चरन्ति । आतमितोरुपतिष्ठन्ते । अग्निमेवोपद्रष्टारं कृत्वा । पितॄन्निरवदयन्ते । अन्तं वा एते प्राणानां गच्छन्ति । य आतमितोरुप तिष्ठन्ते । सुसंदृशं त्वा वयमित्याह

1.6.9.s: prāṇo vai susaṃdṛk | prāṇamevātmandadhate | yojānvindra te harī ityāha | prāṇameva punarayukta | akṣannamīmadanta hīti gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhante | akṣannamīmadantātha tvopatiṣṭhāmaha iti vāvaitadāha | amīmadanta pitaraḥ somyā ityabhi prapadyante | amīmadanta pitaro'tha tvā'bhi prapadyāmaha iti vāvaitadāha | apaḥ pariṣiñcati | mārjayatyevainān
1.6.9.d: प्राणो वै सुसंदृक् । प्राणमेवात्मन्दधते । योजान्विन्द्र ते हरी इत्याह । प्राणमेव पुनरयुक्त । अक्षन्नमीमदन्त हीति गार्हपत्यमुपतिष्ठन्ते । अक्षन्नमीमदन्ताथ त्वोपतिष्ठामह इति वावैतदाह । अमीमदन्त पितरः सोम्या इत्यभि प्रपद्यन्ते । अमीमदन्त पितरोऽथ त्वाऽभि प्रपद्यामह इति वावैतदाह । अपः परिषिञ्चति । मार्जयत्येवैनान्
1.6.9.m: The breath is of lovely sight. / It is breath that they place in themselves. / He says: 'Yoke now, O Indra, your two bay steeds!' / He has yoked the breath anew. / They attend upon the Gārhapatya [fire] with: 'They have eaten, they have rejoiced!' / 'They have eaten, they have rejoiced; now we attend upon you,' is what he indeed says thereby. / They approach with: 'The Soma-loving Fathers have rejoiced!' / 'The Fathers have rejoiced; now we approach you,' is what he indeed says thereby. / He sprinkles water around; / he purifies them.

1.6.9.s: atho tarpayatyeva | tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | ya evaṃ veda | apa barhiṣāvanūyājau yajati | prajā vai barhiḥ | prajā eva mṛtyoruthsṛjati | caturaḥ prayājān yajati | dvāvanūyājau | ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ
1.6.9.d: अथो तर्पयत्येव । तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिः । य एवं वेद । अप बर्हिषावनूयाजौ यजति । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । प्रजा एव मृत्योरुथ्सृजति । चतुरः प्रयाजान् यजति । द्वावनूयाजौ । षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः
1.6.9.m: And thus he also satiates them. / He is satiated with offspring and with domestic animals, / who knows thus. / He offers the two after-offerings without sacred grass. / The sacred grass is offspring. / He delivers the offspring from death. / He offers four fore-offerings / [and] two after-offerings; / they amount to six. / Six are the seasons; / he pleases the seasons. / The wife does not sit beside [the rite]; / they do not perform the consort-offerings. / If the wife were to sit beside [it], / if they were to perform the consort-offerings, / she would be prone to die. / Therefore she does not sit beside [it], / nor do they perform the consort-offerings, / for the protection of the wife.

1.6.9.s: ṛtūneva prīṇāti | na patnyanvāste | na saṃyājayanti | yatpatnyanvāsīta | yathsaṃyājayeyuḥ | pramāyukā syāt | tasmānnānvāste | na saṃyājayanti | patniyai gopīthāya
1.6.9.d: ऋतूनेव प्रीणाति । न पत्न्यन्वास्ते । न संयाजयन्ति । यत्पत्न्यन्वासीत । यथ्संयाजयेयुः । प्रमायुका स्यात् । तस्मान्नान्वास्ते । न संयाजयन्ति । पत्नियै गोपीथाय

1.6.10.s: pratipūruṣamekakapālānnirvapati | jātā eva prajā rudrānniravadayate | ekamatiriktam | janiṣyamāṇā eva prajā rudrānniravadayate | ekakapālā bhavanti | ekadhaiva rudraṃ niravadayate | nābhighārayati | yadabhighārayet | antaravacāriṇaṃ rudraṃ kuryāt | ekolmukena yanti
1.6.10.d: प्रतिपूरुषमेककपालान्निर्वपति । जाता एव प्रजा रुद्रान्निरवदयते । एकमतिरिक्तम् । जनिष्यमाणा एव प्रजा रुद्रान्निरवदयते । एककपाला भवन्ति । एकधैव रुद्रं निरवदयते । नाभिघारयति । यदभिघारयेत् । अन्तरवचारिणं रुद्रं कुर्यात् । एकोल्मुकेन यन्ति
1.6.10.m: He parcels out one-cup-sized cakes for each person. / He appeases Rudra away from the offspring already born. / [He parcels out] one extra; / he appeases Rudra away from the offspring about to be born. / They are on a single potsherd; / in one stroke he appeases Rudra. / He does not pour butter over [them]. / If he were to pour butter over [them], / he would make Rudra dwell within [the village]. / They go with a single firebrand.

1.6.10.s: taddhi rudrasya bhāgadheyam | imāṃ diśaṃ yanti | eṣā vai rudrasya dik | svāyāmeva diśi rudraṃ niravadayate | rudro vā apaśukāyā āhutyai nātiṣṭhata | asau te paśuriti nirdiśedyaṃ dviṣyāt | yameva dveṣṭi | tamasmai paśuṃ nirdiśati | yadi na dviṣyāt | ākhuste paśuriti brūyāt
1.6.10.d: तद्धि रुद्रस्य भागधेयम् । इमां दिशं यन्ति । एषा वै रुद्रस्य दिक् । स्वायामेव दिशि रुद्रं निरवदयते । रुद्रो वा अपशुकाया आहुत्यै नातिष्ठत । असौ ते पशुरिति निर्दिशेद्यं द्विष्यात् । यमेव द्वेष्टि । तमस्मै पशुं निर्दिशति । यदि न द्विष्यात् । आखुस्ते पशुरिति ब्रूयात्
1.6.10.m: For that is Rudra's portion. / They go in this [northern] direction. / For that is Rudra's direction. / In his own direction he appeases Rudra. / Rudra does not abide an offering without cattle. / 'That one is your cattle,' thus he should indicate toward him whom he hates. / Whomever he hates, / him he indicates as cattle for him. / If he should not hate [anyone], / he should say: 'The mole is your cattle.'

1.6.10.s: na grāmyānpaśūn hinasti | nāraṇyān | catuṣpathe juhoti | eṣa vā agnīnāṃ paḍbīśo nāma | agnivatyeva juhoti | madhyamena parṇena juhoti | srugghyeṣā | atho khalu | antamenaiva hotavyam | antata eva rudraṃ niravadayate
1.6.10.d: न ग्राम्यान्पशून् हिनस्ति । नारण्यान् । चतुष्पथे जुहोति । एष वा अग्नीनां पड्बीशो नाम । अग्निवत्येव जुहोति । मध्यमेन पर्णेन जुहोति । स्रुग्घ्येषा । अथो खलु । अन्तमेनैव होतव्यम् । अन्तत एव रुद्रं निरवदयते
1.6.10.m: He harms neither domestic animals / nor wild ones. / He offers at a crossroad. / For that is called the fetter of the fires. / He offers on that which possesses fire. / He offers with a middle palāśa leaf, / for that is a ladle. / And further, / it should be offered with the outermost [leaf]; / from the very boundary he appeases Rudra.

1.6.10.s: eṣa te rudra bhāgaḥ saha svasrā'mbikayetyāha | śaradvā asyāmbikā svasā | tayā vā eṣa hinasti | yaṃ hinasti | tayaivainaṃ saha śamayati | bheṣajaṃ gava ityāha | yāvanta eva grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ | tebhyo bheṣajaṃ karoti | avāmba rudramadimahītyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste
1.6.10.d: एष ते रुद्र भागः सह स्वस्राऽम्बिकयेत्याह । शरद्वा अस्याम्बिका स्वसा । तया वा एष हिनस्ति । यं हिनस्ति । तयैवैनं सह शमयति । भेषजं गव इत्याह । यावन्त एव ग्राम्याः पशवः । तेभ्यो भेषजं करोति । अवाम्ब रुद्रमदिमहीत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते
1.6.10.m: He says: 'This is your share, O Rudra, together with your sister Ambikā.' / Autumn is his sister Ambikā. / With her he harms / whomever he harms; / with her he appeases him. / He says: 'Healing for the cows!' / As many domestic animals as there are, / for them he provides healing. / He says: 'We have appeased Rudra, O mother!' / He thereby prays for this blessing.

1.6.10.s: tryambakaṃ yajāmaha ityāha | mṛtyormukṣīya mā'mṛtāditi vāvaitadāha | utkiranti | bhagasya līpsante | mūte kṛtvā''sajanti | yathā janaṃ yate'vasaṃ karoti | tādṛgeva tat | eṣa te rudra bhāga ityāha niravattyai | apratīkṣamāyanti | apaḥ pariṣiñcati | rudrasyāntarhityai | pra vā ete'smāllokāccyavante | ye tryambakaiścaranti | ādityaṃ caruṃ punaretya nirvapati | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhanti
1.6.10.d: त्र्यम्बकं यजामह इत्याह । मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतादिति वावैतदाह । उत्किरन्ति । भगस्य लीप्सन्ते । मूते कृत्वा'ऽसजन्ति । यथा जनं यतेऽवसं करोति । तादृगेव तत् । एष ते रुद्र भाग इत्याह निरवत्त्यै । अप्रतीक्षमायन्ति । अपः परिषिञ्चति । रुद्रस्यान्तर्हित्यै । प्र वा एतेऽस्माल्लोकाच्च्यवन्ते । ये त्र्यम्बकैश्चरन्ति । आदित्यं चरुं पुनरेत्य निर्वपति । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
1.6.10.m: He says: 'We sacrifice to Tryambaka.' / 'May I be released from death, not from immortality,' is what he indeed says thereby. / They toss [the cakes] up; / they seek to obtain fortune. / Placing [them] in a basket, they hang [them] up. / Just as one provides provisions for a person setting out on a journey, / such indeed is that. / He says: 'This is your share, O Rudra,' for appeasement. / They return facing the point [of the spear]. / He sprinkles water around / to shut out Rudra. / They fall away from this world / who perform the Tryambaka offerings. / Having returned, he distributes a caru for Aditi. / This [earth] is Aditi; / it is on this that they firmly establish themselves.

1.7.1.s: etadbrāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi | athendrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | saṃvathsaro vā indrā śunāsīraḥ | saṃvathsareṇaivāsmā annamavarundhe | vāyavyaṃ payo bhavati | vāyurvai vṛṣṭyai pradāpayitā | sa evāsmai vṛṣṭiṃ pradāpayati | saurya ekakapālo bhavati | sūryeṇa vā amuṣmiṃ lloke vṛṣṭirdhṛtā | sa evāsmai vṛṣṭiṃ niyacchati
1.7.1.d: एतद्ब्राह्मणान्येव पञ्च हवींषि । अथेन्द्राय शुनासीराय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति । संवथ्सरो वा इन्द्रा शुनासीरः । संवथ्सरेणैवास्मा अन्नमवरुन्धे । वायव्यं पयो भवति । वायुर्वै वृष्ट्यै प्रदापयिता । स एवास्मै वृष्टिं प्रदापयति । सौर्य एककपालो भवति । सूर्येण वा अमुष्मिं ल्लोके वृष्टिर्धृता । स एवास्मै वृष्टिं नियच्छति
1.7.1.m: These indeed are the five offerings having explanatory texts. / Then one offers a twelve-pot-sherd cake to Indra Śunāsīra. / Indra Śunāsīra is the year. / By means of the year, he secures food for him. / The milk is dedicated to Vāyu. / Vāyu is the causer of rain. / He causes rain to fall for him. / [The cake] on one pot-sherd is dedicated to Sūrya. / By Sūrya rain is held in that world. / He bestows rain upon him.

1.7.1.s: dvādaśagavaṃ sīraṃ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te devā agnimabruvan | tvayā vīreṇāsurānabhibhavāmeti | so'bravīt | tredhā'hamātmānaṃ vikariṣya iti | sa tredhā''tmānaṃ vyakuruta | agniṃ tṛtīyam | rudraṃ tṛtīyam | varuṇaṃ tṛtīyam
1.7.1.d: द्वादशगवं सीरं दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । ते देवा अग्निमब्रुवन् । त्वया वीरेणासुरानभिभवामेति । सोऽब्रवीत् । त्रेधाऽहमात्मानं विकरिष्य इति । स त्रेधा'ऽत्मानं व्यकुरुत । अग्निं तृतीयम् । रुद्रं तृतीयम् । वरुणं तृतीयम्
1.7.1.m: A plow with twelve oxen is the sacrificial gift for success. / The gods and the asuras were in conflict. / The gods said to Agni: / 'With you as hero, let us overcome the asuras.' / He said: / 'I shall divide myself into three.' / He divided himself into three: / one third [as] Agni, / one third [as] Rudra, / one third [as] Varuṇa.

1.7.1.s: so'bravīt | ka idaṃ turīyamiti | ahamitīndro'bravīt | saṃ tu sṛjāvahā iti | tau samasṛjetām | sa indrasturīyamabhavat | yadindrasturīyamabhavat | tadindraturīyasyendraturīyatvam | tato vai devā vyajayanta | yadindraturīyaṃ nirupyate vijityai
1.7.1.d: सोऽब्रवीत् । क इदं तुरीयमिति । अहमितीन्द्रोऽब्रवीत् । सं तु सृजावहा इति । तौ समसृजेताम् । स इन्द्रस्तुरीयमभवत् । यदिन्द्रस्तुरीयमभवत् । तदिन्द्रतुरीयस्येन्द्रतुरीयत्वम् । ततो वै देवा व्यजयन्त । यदिन्द्रतुरीयं निरुप्यते विजित्यै
1.7.1.m: He said: / 'Who is this fourth?' / 'I [am],' said Indra. / 'Let us two unite.' / They two united. / Indra became the fourth. / Because Indra became the fourth, / that is the Indraturīya nature of the Indraturīya. / Then indeed the gods conquered. / The Indraturīya is offered for victory.

1.7.1.s: vahinī dhenurdakṣiṇā | yadvahinī | tenā''gneyī | yadgauḥ | tena raudrī | yaddhenuḥ | tenaindrī | yathstrī satī dāntā | tena vāruṇī samṛddhyai | prajāpatiryajñamasṛjata
1.7.1.d: वहिनी धेनुर्दक्षिणा । यद्वहिनी । तेना'ऽग्नेयी । यद्गौः । तेन रौद्री । यद्धेनुः । तेनैन्द्री । यथ्स्त्री सती दान्ता । तेन वारुणी समृद्ध्यै । प्रजापतिर्यज्ञमसृजत
1.7.1.m: A draft cow is the sacrificial gift. / In that she is a draft animal, thereby she belongs to Agni. / In that she is a bovine, / thereby she belongs to Rudra. / In that she is a milch cow, / thereby she belongs to Indra. / In that, being female, she is tamed, / thereby she belongs to Varuṇa, for success. / Prajāpati created the sacrifice.

1.7.1.s: taṃ sṛṣṭaṃ rakṣāṃsyajighāṃsan | sa etāḥ prajāpatirātmano devatā niramimīta | tābhirvai sa digbhyo rakṣāṃsi prāṇudata | yatpañcāvattīyaṃ juhoti | digbhya eva tadyajamāno rakṣāṃsi praṇudate | samūḍhaṃ rakṣaḥ saṃdagdhaṃ rakṣa ityāha | rakṣāṃsyeva saṃdahati | agnaye rakṣoghne svāhetyāha | devatābhya eva vijigyānābhyo bhāgadheyaṃ karoti | praṣṭivāhī ratho dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai
1.7.1.d: तं सृष्टं रक्षांस्यजिघांसन् । स एताः प्रजापतिरात्मनो देवता निरमिमीत । ताभिर्वै स दिग्भ्यो रक्षांसि प्राणुदत । यत्पञ्चावत्तीयं जुहोति । दिग्भ्य एव तद्यजमानो रक्षांसि प्रणुदते । समूढं रक्षः संदग्धं रक्ष इत्याह । रक्षांस्येव संदहति । अग्नये रक्षोघ्ने स्वाहेत्याह । देवताभ्य एव विजिग्यानाभ्यो भागधेयं करोति । प्रष्टिवाही रथो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै
1.7.1.m: The demons sought to slay it when created. / Prajāpati fashioned these deities from himself. / With them he drove the demons away from the quarters. / When he offers the five-fold portion, / the sacrificer thereby drives the demons away from the quarters. / He says, 'The demon is swept together; the demon is consumed by fire.' / He burns up the demons. / He says, 'To Agni, slayer of demons, svāhā.' / He assigns a share to the deities who have won victory. / A chariot drawn by three horses is the sacrificial gift for success.

1.7.1.s: indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | asurānparābhāvya | namucimāsuraṃ nālabhata | taṃ śacyā'gṛhṇāt | tau samalabhetām | so'smādabhiśunataro'bhavat | so'bravīt | saṃdhāṃ saṃdadhāvahai | atha tvā'va srakṣyāmi | na mā śuṣkeṇa nārdreṇa hanaḥ
1.7.1.d: इन्द्रो वृत्रं हत्वा । असुरान्पराभाव्य । नमुचिमासुरं नालभत । तं शच्याऽगृह्णात् । तौ समलभेताम् । सोऽस्मादभिशुनतरोऽभवत् । सोऽब्रवीत् । संधां संदधावहै । अथ त्वाऽव स्रक्ष्यामि । न मा शुष्केण नार्द्रेण हनः
1.7.1.m: Indra, having slain Vṛtra, / having defeated the asuras, / could not seize Namuci the asura. / He seized him by force. / The two struggled together. / He was stronger than he. / He said: / 'Let us two make a pact; / then I will let you go: / you shall not kill me with what is dry, nor with what is wet,

1.7.1.s: na divā na naktamiti | sa etamapāṃ phenamasiñcat | na vā eṣa śuṣko nārdro vyuṣṭā''sīt | anuditaḥ sūryaḥ | na vā etaddivā na naktam | tasyaitasmiṃlloke | apāṃ phenena śira udavartayat | tadenamanvavartata | mitradrugiti
1.7.1.d: न दिवा न नक्तमिति । स एतमपां फेनमसिञ्चत् । न वा एष शुष्को नार्द्रो व्युष्टा'ऽसीत् । अनुदितः सूर्यः । न वा एतद्दिवा न नक्तम् । तस्यैतस्मिंल्लोके । अपां फेनेन शिर उदवर्तयत् । तदेनमन्ववर्तत । मित्रद्रुगिति
1.7.1.m: nor by day, nor by night.' / He poured out this foam of the waters. / That is neither dry nor wet; it was dawn; / the sun was unrisen; / that is neither day nor night. / In that realm, / he struck off his head with the foam of the waters. / That [head] pursued him, / [crying,] 'Slayer of a friend!'

1.7.1.s: sa etānapāmārgānajanayat | tānajuhot | tairvai sa rakṣāṃsyapāhata | yadapāmārgahomo bhavati | rakṣasāmapahatyai | ekolmukena yanti | taddhi rakṣasāṃ bhāgadheyam | imāṃ diśaṃ yanti | eṣā vai rakṣasāṃ dik | svāyāmeva diśi rakṣāṃsi hanti
1.7.1.d: स एतानपामार्गानजनयत् । तानजुहोत् । तैर्वै स रक्षांस्यपाहत । यदपामार्गहोमो भवति । रक्षसामपहत्यै । एकोल्मुकेन यन्ति । तद्धि रक्षसां भागधेयम् । इमां दिशं यन्ति । एषा वै रक्षसां दिक् । स्वायामेव दिशि रक्षांसि हन्ति
1.7.1.m: He generated these apāmārga plants. / He offered them. / With them he repelled the demons. / That there is an offering of apāmārga / is for repelling the demons. / They go with a single firebrand; / for that is the share of the demons. / They go in this direction; / for that is the direction of the demons. / In their own direction he slays the demons.

1.7.1.s: svakṛta iriṇe juhoti pradare vā | etadvai rakṣasāmāyatanam | sva evāyatane rakṣāṃsi hanti | parṇamayena sruveṇa juhoti | brahma vai parṇaḥ | brahmaṇaiva rakṣāṃsi hanti | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityāha | savitṛprasūta eva rakṣāṃsi hanti | hataṃ rakṣo'vadhiṣma rakṣa ityāha | rakṣasāg stṛtyai | yadvaste taddakṣiṇā niravattyai | apratīkṣamāyanti | rakṣasāmantarhityai
1.7.1.d: स्वकृत इरिणे जुहोति प्रदरे वा । एतद्वै रक्षसामायतनम् । स्व एवायतने रक्षांसि हन्ति । पर्णमयेन स्रुवेण जुहोति । ब्रह्म वै पर्णः । ब्रह्मणैव रक्षांसि हन्ति । देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्याह । सवितृप्रसूत एव रक्षांसि हन्ति । हतं रक्षोऽवधिष्म रक्ष इत्याह । रक्षसाग् स्तृत्यै । यद्वस्ते तद्दक्षिणा निरवत्त्यै । अप्रतीक्षमायन्ति । रक्षसामन्तर्हित्यै
1.7.1.m: He offers in a natural barren spot or in a cleft; / for that is the abode of the demons. / In their own abode he slays the demons. / He offers with a spoon of parṇa wood; / the parṇa wood is brahman; / by brahman he slays the demons. / He says, 'At the impulse of divine Savitṛ'; / impelled by Savitṛ he slays the demons. / He says, 'Slain is the demon; we have killed the demon,' / for laying low the demons. / What he wears is the sacrificial gift, for removal. / They return without looking back, / for keeping off the demons.

1.7.2.s: dhātre puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | saṃvathsaro vai dhātā | saṃvathsareṇaivāsmai prajāḥ prajanayati | anvevāsmā anumatirmanyate | rāte rākā | pra sinīvālī janayati | prajāsveva prajātāsu kuhvā vācaṃ dadhāti | mithunau gāvau dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | aindrāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālam
1.7.2.d: धात्रे पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति । संवथ्सरो वै धाता । संवथ्सरेणैवास्मै प्रजाः प्रजनयति । अन्वेवास्मा अनुमतिर्मन्यते । राते राका । प्र सिनीवाली जनयति । प्रजास्वेव प्रजातासु कुह्वा वाचं दधाति । मिथुनौ गावौ दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । आग्नावैष्णवमेकादशकपालं निर्वपति । ऐन्द्रावैष्णवमेकादशकपालम्
1.7.2.m: He offers a twelve-pot-sherd cake to Dhātṛ. / Dhātṛ is the year. / By means of the year, he generates offspring for him. / Anumati assents for him; / Rākā grants; / Sinīvālī brings forth; / when the offspring are brought forth, Kuhū places speech [in them]. / A pair of bovines is the sacrificial gift for success. / He offers an eleven-pot-sherd cake to Agni and Viṣṇu, / an eleven-pot-sherd cake to Indra and Viṣṇu,

1.7.2.s: vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālam | vīryaṃ vā agniḥ | vīryamindraḥ | vīryaṃ viṣṇuḥ | prajā eva prajātā vīrye pratiṣṭhāpayati | tasmātprajā vīryāvatīḥ | vāmana ṛṣabho vahī dakṣiṇā | yadvahī | tenāgneyaḥ | yadṛṣabhaḥ
1.7.2.d: वैष्णवं त्रिकपालम् । वीर्यं वा अग्निः । वीर्यमिन्द्रः । वीर्यं विष्णुः । प्रजा एव प्रजाता वीर्ये प्रतिष्ठापयति । तस्मात्प्रजा वीर्यावतीः । वामन ऋषभो वही दक्षिणा । यद्वही । तेनाग्नेयः । यदृषभः
1.7.2.m: a three-pot-sherd cake to Viṣṇu. / Agni is heroic power; / Indra is heroic power; / Viṣṇu is heroic power. / He establishes the offspring, once brought forth, in heroic power; / therefore offspring possess heroic power. / A dwarf bull, a draft animal, is the sacrificial gift. / In that he is a draft animal, thereby he belongs to Agni. / In that he is a bull,

1.7.2.s: tenaindraḥ | yadvāmanaḥ | tena vaiṣṇavaḥ samṛddhyai | agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | indrāsomīyamekādaśakapālam | saumyaṃ carum | somo vai retodhāḥ | agniḥ prajānāṃ prajanayitā | vṛddhānāmindraḥ pradāpayitā | soma evāsmai reto dadhāti
1.7.2.d: तेनैन्द्रः । यद्वामनः । तेन वैष्णवः समृद्ध्यै । अग्नीषोमीयमेकादशकपालं निर्वपति । इन्द्रासोमीयमेकादशकपालम् । सौम्यं चरुम् । सोमो वै रेतोधाः । अग्निः प्रजानां प्रजनयिता । वृद्धानामिन्द्रः प्रदापयिता । सोम एवास्मै रेतो दधाति
1.7.2.m: thereby he belongs to Indra. / In that he is a dwarf, / thereby he belongs to Viṣṇu, for success. / He offers an eleven-pot-sherd cake to Agni and Soma, / an eleven-pot-sherd cake to Indra and Soma, / a mess of boiled rice to Soma. / Soma is the placer of semen; / Agni is the progenitor of offspring; / Indra is the dispenser of what has grown. / Soma places semen in him;

1.7.2.s: agniḥ prajāṃ prajanayati | vṛddhāmindraḥ prayacchati | babhrurdakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | somāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapati | aindrāpauṣṇaṃ carum | somo vai retodhāḥ | pūṣā paśūnāṃ prajanayitā | vṛddhānāmindraḥ pradāpayitā | soma evāsmai reto dadhāti | pūṣā paśūnprajanayati ||
1.7.2.d: अग्निः प्रजां प्रजनयति । वृद्धामिन्द्रः प्रयच्छति । बभ्रुर्दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । सोमापौष्णं चरुं निर्वपति । ऐन्द्रापौष्णं चरुम् । सोमो वै रेतोधाः । पूषा पशूनां प्रजनयिता । वृद्धानामिन्द्रः प्रदापयिता । सोम एवास्मै रेतो दधाति । पूषा पशून्प्रजनयति ॥
1.7.2.m: Agni brings forth offspring; / Indra bestows them when grown. / A reddish-brown animal is the sacrificial gift for success. / He offers a mess of boiled rice to Soma and Pūṣan, / a mess of boiled rice to Indra and Pūṣan. / Soma is the placer of semen; / Pūṣan is the progenitor of domestic animals; / Indra is the dispenser of what has grown. / Soma places semen in him; / Pūṣan brings forth domestic animals;

1.7.2.s: vṛddhānindraḥ prayacchati | pauṣṇaścarurbhavati | iyaṃ vai pūṣā | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | śyāmo dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | bahu vai puruṣo medhyamupagacchati | vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | saṃvathsaro vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ | saṃvathsareṇaivainaṃ svadayati | hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā
1.7.2.d: वृद्धानिन्द्रः प्रयच्छति । पौष्णश्चरुर्भवति । इयं वै पूषा । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति । श्यामो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । बहु वै पुरुषो मेध्यमुपगच्छति । वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति । संवथ्सरो वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः । संवथ्सरेणैवैनं स्वदयति । हिरण्यं दक्षिणा
1.7.2.m: Indra bestows them when grown. / There is a mess of boiled rice to Pūṣan. / Pūṣan is this [earth]; / he is established upon her. / A dark-colored animal is the sacrificial gift for success. / A man enters into much that is impure. / He offers a twelve-pot-sherd cake to Vaiśvānara. / Agni Vaiśvānara is the year. / By means of the year, he sweetens him. / Gold is the sacrificial gift.

1.7.2.s: pavitraṃ vai hiraṇyam | punātyevainam | bahu vai rājanyo'nṛtaṃ karoti | upajāmyai harate | jināti brāhmaṇam | vadatyanṛtam | anṛte khalu vai kriyamāṇe varuṇo gṛhṇāti | vāruṇaṃ yavamayaṃ caruṃ nirvapati | varuṇapāśādevainaṃ muñcati | aśvo dakṣiṇā | vāruṇo hi devatayā'śvaḥ samṛddhyai
1.7.2.d: पवित्रं वै हिरण्यम् । पुनात्येवैनम् । बहु वै राजन्योऽनृतं करोति । उपजाम्यै हरते । जिनाति ब्राह्मणम् । वदत्यनृतम् । अनृते खलु वै क्रियमाणे वरुणो गृह्णाति । वारुणं यवमयं चरुं निर्वपति । वरुणपाशादेवैनं मुञ्चति । अश्वो दक्षिणा । वारुणो हि देवतयाऽश्वः समृद्ध्यै
1.7.2.m: Gold is a purifier; / it purifies him. / A Rājanya commits much untruth: / he robs a relative; / he oppresses a Brahmin; / he speaks untruth. / When untruth is committed, Varuṇa seizes [him]. / He offers a mess of boiled barley to Varuṇa. / He frees him from Varuṇa's fetter. / A horse is the sacrificial gift; / for the horse belongs to Varuṇa by deity, for success.

1.7.3.s: ratnināmetāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | ete vai rāṣṭrasya pradātāraḥ | ete'pādātāraḥ | ya eva rāṣṭrasya pradātāraḥ | ye'pādātāraḥ | ta evāsmai rāṣṭraṃ prayacchanti | rāṣṭrameva bhavati | yathsamāhṛtya nirvapet | aratninaḥ syuḥ | yathāyathaṃ nirvapati ratnitvāya
1.7.3.d: रत्निनामेतानि हवींषि भवन्ति । एते वै राष्ट्रस्य प्रदातारः । एतेऽपादातारः । य एव राष्ट्रस्य प्रदातारः । येऽपादातारः । त एवास्मै राष्ट्रं प्रयच्छन्ति । राष्ट्रमेव भवति । यथ्समाहृत्य निर्वपेत् । अरत्निनः स्युः । यथायथं निर्वपति रत्नित्वाय
1.7.3.m:
These are the oblations of the jewel-holders (ratnins).
These indeed are the givers of the realm;
these are the takers away.
Those who indeed are the givers of the realm,
those who are the takers away,
they indeed bestow the realm upon him.
He indeed comes to have a realm.
If he were to offer [them all] together,
they would become non-jewel-holders.
He offers them one by one, for the status of jewel-holders.

1.7.3.s: yathsadyo nirvapet | yāvatīmekena haviṣā''śiṣamava rundhe | tāvatīmavarundhīta | anvahaṃ nirvapati | bhūyasīmevāśiṣamavarundhe | bhūyaso yajñakratūnupaiti | bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapati brahmaṇo gṛhe | mukhata evāsmai brahma saṃśyati | atho brahmanneva kṣattramanvārambhayati | śitipṛṣṭho dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai
1.7.3.d: यथ्सद्यो निर्वपेत् । यावतीमेकेन हविषा'ऽशिषमव रुन्धे । तावतीमवरुन्धीत । अन्वहं निर्वपति । भूयसीमेवाशिषमवरुन्धे । भूयसो यज्ञक्रतूनुपैति । बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं निर्वपति ब्रह्मणो गृहे । मुखत एवास्मै ब्रह्म संश्यति । अथो ब्रह्मन्नेव क्षत्त्रमन्वारम्भयति । शितिपृष्ठो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै

1.7.3.s: aindramekādaśakapālaṃ rājanyasya gṛhe | indriyamevāvarundhe | ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | ādityaṃ caruṃ mahiṣyai gṛhe | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | dhenurdakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | bhagāya caruṃ vāvātāyai gṛhe | bhagamevāsmindadhāti | vicittagarbhā paṣṭhauhī dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai
1.7.3.d: ऐन्द्रमेकादशकपालं राजन्यस्य गृहे । इन्द्रियमेवावरुन्धे । ऋषभो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । आदित्यं चरुं महिष्यै गृहे । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति । धेनुर्दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । भगाय चरुं वावातायै गृहे । भगमेवास्मिन्दधाति । विचित्तगर्भा पष्ठौही दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै

1.7.3.s: nairṛtaṃ caruṃ parivṛktyai gṛhe kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ nakhanirbhinnam | pāpmānameva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | kṛṣṇā kūṭā dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ senānyo gṛhe | senāmevāsya saṃśyati | hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | vāruṇaṃ daśakapālaṃ sūtasya gṛhe | varuṇasavamevāvarundhe | mahāniraṣṭo dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | mārutaṃ saptakapālaṃ grāmaṇyo gṛhe
1.7.3.d: नैरृतं चरुं परिवृक्त्यै गृहे कृष्णानां व्रीहीणां नखनिर्भिन्नम् । पाप्मानमेव निरृतिं निरवदयते । कृष्णा कूटा दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । आग्नेयमष्टाकपालं सेनान्यो गृहे । सेनामेवास्य संश्यति । हिरण्यं दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । वारुणं दशकपालं सूतस्य गृहे । वरुणसवमेवावरुन्धे । महानिरष्टो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । मारुतं सप्तकपालं ग्रामण्यो गृहे

1.7.3.s: annaṃ vai marutaḥ | annamevāvarundhe | pṛśnirdakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ kṣatturgṛhe prasūtyai | upadhvasto dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ saṃgrahīturgṛhe | aśvinau vai devānāṃ bhiṣajau | tābhyāmevāsmai bheṣajaṃ karoti | savātyau dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ bhāgadughasya gṛhe
1.7.3.d: अन्नं वै मरुतः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । पृश्निर्दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । सावित्रं द्वादशकपालं क्षत्तुर्गृहे प्रसूत्यै । उपध्वस्तो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । आश्विनं द्विकपालं संग्रहीतुर्गृहे । अश्विनौ वै देवानां भिषजौ । ताभ्यामेवास्मै भेषजं करोति । सवात्यौ दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । पौष्णं चरुं भागदुघस्य गृहे

1.7.3.s: annaṃ vai pūṣā | annamevāvarundhe | śyāmo dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | raudraṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carumakṣāvāpasya gṛhe | antata eva rudraṃ niravadayate | śabala udvāro dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | dvādaśaitāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsareṇaivāsmai rāṣṭramavarundhe | rāṣṭrameva bhavati
1.7.3.d: अन्नं वै पूषा । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । श्यामो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । रौद्रं गावीधुकं चरुमक्षावापस्य गृहे । अन्तत एव रुद्रं निरवदयते । शबल उद्वारो दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । द्वादशैतानि हवींषि भवन्ति । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सरेणैवास्मै राष्ट्रमवरुन्धे । राष्ट्रमेव भवति

1.7.3.s: yanna pratinirvapet | ratnina āśiṣo'varundhīrann | pratinirvapati | indrāya sutrāmṇe puroḍāśamekādaśakapālam | indrāyāṃhomuce | āśiṣa evāvarundhe | ayanno rājā vṛtrahā rājā bhūtvā vṛtraṃ vadhyādityāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | maitrābārhaspatyaṃ bhavati | śvetāyai śvetavathsāyai dugdhe
1.7.3.d: यन्न प्रतिनिर्वपेत् । रत्निन आशिषोऽवरुन्धीरन्न् । प्रतिनिर्वपति । इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे पुरोडाशमेकादशकपालम् । इन्द्रायांहोमुचे । आशिष एवावरुन्धे । अयन्नो राजा वृत्रहा राजा भूत्वा वृत्रं वध्यादित्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यं भवति । श्वेतायै श्वेतवथ्सायै दुग्धे
1.7.3.m:
If he were not to offer a counter-oblation,
the jewel-holders would secure the wishes.
He offers counter-oblations:
an eleven-pot-sherd cake to Indra Sutrāman,
[and one] to Indra Aṃhomuc.
He secures the wishes.
'Coming to us as king, the slayer of Vṛtra, becoming king / may he strike Vṛtra,' he says;
this very wish he expresses.
There is an offering to Mitra and Bṛhaspati,
in the milk of a white cow having a white calf.

1.7.3.s: bārhaspatye maitramapi dadhāti | brahma caivāsmai kṣattraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | atho brahmanneva kṣattraṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | bārhaspatyena pūrveṇa pracarati | mukhata evāsmai brahma saṃśyati | atho brahmanneva kṣattramanvārambhayati | svayaṃkṛtā vedirbhavati | svayaṃdinaṃ barhiḥ | svayaṃkṛta idhmaḥ | anabhijitasyābhijityai | tasmādrājñāmaraṇyamabhijitam | saiva śvetā śvetavathsā dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai
1.7.3.d: बार्हस्पत्ये मैत्रमपि दधाति । ब्रह्म चैवास्मै क्षत्त्रं च समीची दधाति । अथो ब्रह्मन्नेव क्षत्त्रं प्रतिष्ठापयति । बार्हस्पत्येन पूर्वेण प्रचरति । मुखत एवास्मै ब्रह्म संश्यति । अथो ब्रह्मन्नेव क्षत्त्रमन्वारम्भयति । स्वयंकृता वेदिर्भवति । स्वयंदिनं बर्हिः । स्वयंकृत इध्मः । अनभिजितस्याभिजित्यै । तस्माद्राज्ञामरण्यमभिजितम् । सैव श्वेता श्वेतवथ्सा दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै

1.7.4.s: devasuvāmetāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | etāvanto vai devānāṃ savāḥ | ta evāsmai savānprayacchanti | ta enaṃ suvante | agnirevainaṃ gṛhapatīnāṃ suvate | somo vanaspatīnām | rudraḥ paśūnām | bṛhaspatirvācām | indro jyeṣṭhānām | mitraḥ satyānām
1.7.4.d: देवसुवामेतानि हवींषि भवन्ति । एतावन्तो वै देवानां सवाः । त एवास्मै सवान्प्रयच्छन्ति । त एनं सुवन्ते । अग्निरेवैनं गृहपतीनां सुवते । सोमो वनस्पतीनाम् । रुद्रः पशूनाम् । बृहस्पतिर्वाचाम् । इन्द्रो ज्येष्ठानाम् । मित्रः सत्यानाम्

1.7.4.s: varuṇo dharmapatīnām | etadeva sarvaṃ bhavati | savitā tvā prasavānāṃ suvatāmiti hastaṃ gṛhṇāti prasūtyai | ye devā devasuvaḥ sthetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | mahate kṣattrāya mahata ādhipatyāya mahate jānarājyāyetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | eṣa vo bharatā rājā somo'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājetyāha | tasmāthsomarājāno brāhmaṇāḥ | pratityannāma rājyamadhāyītyāha
1.7.4.d: वरुणो धर्मपतीनाम् । एतदेव सर्वं भवति । सविता त्वा प्रसवानां सुवतामिति हस्तं गृह्णाति प्रसूत्यै । ये देवा देवसुवः स्थेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । महते क्षत्त्राय महत आधिपत्याय महते जानराज्यायेत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । एष वो भरता राजा सोमोऽस्माकं ब्राह्मणानां राजेत्याह । तस्माथ्सोमराजानो ब्राह्मणाः । प्रतित्यन्नाम राज्यमधायीत्याह

1.7.4.s: rājyamevāsmin pratidadhāti | svāṃ tanuvaṃ varuṇo aśiśredityāha | varuṇasavamevāvarundhe | śucermitrasya vratyā abhūmetyāha | śucimevainaṃ vratyaṃ karoti | amanmahi mahata ṛtasya nāmetyāha | manuta evainam | sarve vrātā varuṇasyābhūvannityāha | sarvavrātamevainaṃ karoti | vi mitra evairarātimatārīdityāha
1.7.4.d: राज्यमेवास्मिन् प्रतिदधाति । स्वां तनुवं वरुणो अशिश्रेदित्याह । वरुणसवमेवावरुन्धे । शुचेर्मित्रस्य व्रत्या अभूमेत्याह । शुचिमेवैनं व्रत्यं करोति । अमन्महि महत ऋतस्य नामेत्याह । मनुत एवैनम् । सर्वे व्राता वरुणस्याभूवन्नित्याह । सर्वव्रातमेवैनं करोति । वि मित्र एवैररातिमतारीदित्याह

1.7.4.s: arātimevainaṃ tārayati | asūṣudanta yajñiyā ṛtenetyāha | svadayatyevainam | vyutrito jarimāṇaṃ na ānaḍityāha | āyurevāsmindadhāti | dvābhyāṃ vimṛṣṭe | dvipādyajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai | agnīṣomīyasya caikādaśakapālasya devasuvāṃ ca haviṣāmagnaye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati | devatābhirevainamubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | viṣṇukramānkramate | viṣṇureva bhūtvemān lokānabhijayati
1.7.4.d: अरातिमेवैनं तारयति । असूषुदन्त यज्ञिया ऋतेनेत्याह । स्वदयत्येवैनम् । व्युत्रितो जरिमाणं न आनडित्याह । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधाति । द्वाभ्यां विमृष्टे । द्विपाद्यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यै । अग्नीषोमीयस्य चैकादशकपालस्य देवसुवां च हविषामग्नये स्विष्टकृते समवद्यति । देवताभिरेवैनमुभयतः परिगृह्णाति । विष्णुक्रमान्क्रमते । विष्णुरेव भूत्वेमान् लोकानभिजयति

1.7.5.s: arthetaḥ stheti juhoti | āhutyaivainā niṣkrīya gṛhṇāti | atho haviṣkṛtānāmevābhighṛtānāṃ gṛhṇāti | vahantīnāṃ gṛhṇāti | etā vā apāṃ rāṣṭram | rāṣṭramevāsmai gṛhṇāti | atho śriyamevainamabhivahanti | apāṃ patirasītyāha | mithunamevākaḥ | vṛṣā'syūrmirityāha
1.7.5.d: अर्थेतः स्थेति जुहोति । आहुत्यैवैना निष्क्रीय गृह्णाति । अथो हविष्कृतानामेवाभिघृतानां गृह्णाति । वहन्तीनां गृह्णाति । एता वा अपां राष्ट्रम् । राष्ट्रमेवास्मै गृह्णाति । अथो श्रियमेवैनमभिवहन्ति । अपां पतिरसीत्याह । मिथुनमेवाकः । वृषाऽस्यूर्मिरित्याह

1.7.5.s: ūrmimantamevainaṃ karoti | vṛṣaseno'sītyāha | senāmevāsya saṃśyati | vrajakṣitaḥ sthetyāha | etā vā apāṃ viśaḥ | viśamevāsmai paryūhati | marutāmojaḥ sthetyāha | annaṃ vai marutaḥ | annamevāvarundhe | sūryavarcasaḥ sthetyāha
1.7.5.d: ऊर्मिमन्तमेवैनं करोति । वृषसेनोऽसीत्याह । सेनामेवास्य संश्यति । व्रजक्षितः स्थेत्याह । एता वा अपां विशः । विशमेवास्मै पर्यूहति । मरुतामोजः स्थेत्याह । अन्नं वै मरुतः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । सूर्यवर्चसः स्थेत्याह
1.7.5.m: He makes him billowy. / 'You are possessed of a mighty army,' he says; / he sharpens his army. / 'You abide in the enclosure,' he says; / these [waters] indeed are the clans of the waters; / he gathers the clan about him. / 'You are the splendorous might of the Maruts,' he says; / the Maruts indeed are food; / he secures food. / 'You have the splendor of the sun,' he says;

1.7.5.s: rāṣṭrameva varcasvyakaḥ | sūryatvacasaḥ sthetyāha | satyaṃ vā etat | yadvarṣati | anṛtaṃ yadā tapati varṣati | satyānṛte evāvarundhe | nainaṃ satyānṛte udite hiṃstaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | māndāḥ sthetyāha | rāṣṭrameva brahmavarcasyakaḥ
1.7.5.d: राष्ट्रमेव वर्चस्व्यकः । सूर्यत्वचसः स्थेत्याह । सत्यं वा एतत् । यद्वर्षति । अनृतं यदा तपति वर्षति । सत्यानृते एवावरुन्धे । नैनं सत्यानृते उदिते हिंस्तः । य एवं वेद । मान्दाः स्थेत्याह । राष्ट्रमेव ब्रह्मवर्चस्यकः
1.7.5.m: he makes the realm radiant. / 'You have the skin of the sun,' he says; / this indeed is truth, / when it rains; / it is untruth when it shines while raining; / he secures both truth and untruth. / Truth and untruth do not harm him when spoken, / whoever knows thus. / 'You are soothing,' he says; / he makes the realm possessed of spiritual preeminence.

1.7.5.s: vāśāḥ sthetyāha | rāṣṭrameva vaśyakaḥ | śakvarīḥ sthetyāha | paśavo vai śakvarīḥ | paśūnevāvarundhe | viśvabhṛtaḥ sthetyāha | rāṣṭrameva payasvyakaḥ | janabhṛtaḥ sthetyāha | rāṣṭramevendriyāvyakaḥ | agnestejasyāḥ sthetyāha
1.7.5.d: वाशाः स्थेत्याह । राष्ट्रमेव वश्यकः । शक्वरीः स्थेत्याह । पशवो वै शक्वरीः । पशूनेवावरुन्धे । विश्वभृतः स्थेत्याह । राष्ट्रमेव पयस्व्यकः । जनभृतः स्थेत्याह । राष्ट्रमेवेन्द्रियाव्यकः । अग्नेस्तेजस्याः स्थेत्याह
1.7.5.m: 'You are compliant,' he says; / he makes the realm obedient. / 'You are powerful,' he says; / the Śakvarī meters are domestic animals; / he secures domestic animals. / 'You are all-supporting,' he says; / he makes the realm rich in milk. / 'You are folk-supporting,' he says; / he makes the realm possessed of sensory faculty. / 'You belong to the fiery energy of Agni,' he says;

1.7.5.s: rāṣṭrameva tejasvyakaḥ | apāmoṣadhīnāṃ rasaḥ sthetyāha | rāṣṭrameva madhavyamakaḥ | sārasvataṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti | eṣā vā apāṃ pṛṣṭham | yathsarasvatī | pṛṣṭhamevainaṃ samānānāṃ karoti | ṣoḍaśabhirgṛhṇāti | ṣoḍaśakalo vai puruṣaḥ | yāvāneva puruṣaḥ | tasminvīryaṃ dadhāti | ṣoḍaśabhirjuhoti ṣoḍaśabhirgṛhṇāti | dvātriṃśathsaṃpadyante | dvātriṃśadakṣarā'nuṣṭuk | vāganuṣṭup sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | vācaivainaṃ sarvebhiśchandobhirabhiṣiñcati
